subject_verb_agreement.r: either … or → V theo N gần

subject_verb_agreement.q: The number of cars on the road ____ every year.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "The number of" → số ít.
subject_verb_agreement.r: the number of + V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: A number of problems ____ been reported.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "A number of" = nhiều → số nhiều.
subject_verb_agreement.r: a number of + V số nhiều

subject_verb_agreement.q: What we need ____ more time.
subject_verb_agreement.e: Mệnh đề "What…" làm chủ ngữ → số ít.
subject_verb_agreement.r: What-clause + V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: The news about the elections ____ surprising.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "news" không đếm được → số ít.
subject_verb_agreement.r: news + V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: Two thirds of the cake ____ been eaten.
subject_verb_agreement.e: Phân số + N số ít / không đếm được → số ít.
subject_verb_agreement.r: phân số + of + N (số ít) → V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: Two thirds of the students ____ passed.
subject_verb_agreement.e: Phân số + N số nhiều → số nhiều.
subject_verb_agreement.r: phân số + of + N số nhiều → V số nhiều

subject_verb_agreement.q: Every boy and girl ____ a present.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "Every A and B" → số ít.
subject_verb_agreement.r: every + N and N → V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: The statistics ____ that unemployment is falling.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "statistics" (các số liệu) → số nhiều. (Môn Thống kê mới là số ít.)
subject_verb_agreement.r: statistics (số liệu) + V số nhiều

subject_verb_agreement.q: The rich ____ to pay more tax under the new plan.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "the + adj" chỉ nhóm người → số nhiều.
subject_verb_agreement.r: the rich / the poor + V số nhiều

subject_verb_agreement.q: Not only the students but also the teacher ____ tired.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "Not only … but also": theo danh từ gần ("the teacher").
subject_verb_agreement.r: not only … but also → V theo N gần

subject_verb_agreement.q: My jeans (A) is (B) too (C) tight (D) now.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "jeans" (đồ có 2 ống) → số nhiều "are".
subject_verb_agreement.r: jeans / trousers + V số nhiều

subject_verb_agreement.q: The quality of the products (A) have (B) improved (C) a lot (D) recently.
subject_verb_agreement.e: Chủ ngữ chính "The quality" → "has".
subject_verb_agreement.r: N1 of N2 → V theo N1

subject_verb_agreement.q: Everyone in the office (A) were (B) invited (C) to (D) the party.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "Everyone" → số ít "was".
subject_verb_agreement.r: everyone + V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: The information (A) you gave me (B) were (C) very (D) useful.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "information" không đếm được → "was".
subject_verb_agreement.r: không đếm được + V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: Both Tom and his brother play football.
o: Tom, as well as his brother, plays football.
Tom, as well as his brother, play football.
Tom as well as his brother are playing football.
Tom, as well as his brother, playing football.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "as well as" không làm chủ ngữ thành số nhiều → "plays".
subject_verb_agreement.r: S + as well as + … → V theo S

subject_verb_agreement.q: The number of students in the class ____ increased.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "The number of" + động từ số ít.
subject_verb_agreement.r: the number of + V số ít ; a number of + V số nhiều

subject_verb_agreement.q: Each of the boxes ____ a label.
subject_verb_agreement.e: "Each of + danh từ số nhiều" + động từ số ít.
subject_verb_agreement.r: each of + V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: Economics ____ more students every year at this university.
subject_verb_agreement.e: Môn học tận cùng -s (economics, physics) là danh từ số ít → attracts.
subject_verb_agreement.r: Môn học -ics + V số ít

subject_verb_agreement.q: The list of items (A) that (B) we need (C) are (D) on the table.
subject_verb_agreement.e: Chủ ngữ chính là "The list" (số ít) → "is".
subject_verb_agreement.r: Động từ hoà hợp với danh từ chính, không với "of + N"

passive_voice.q: The new bridge ____ next year.
passive_voice.e: Cây cầu không tự xây → bị động tương lai: will be + V3.
w: chủ động, cầu không tự xây
chủ động tiếp diễn, sai nghĩa

passive_voice.q: English ____ in many countries around the world.
passive_voice.e: Ngôn ngữ "được nói" → bị động hiện tại đơn.
w: chủ động, tiếng Anh không tự nói
chủ động tiếp diễn, sai nghĩa

passive_voice.q: The letter ____ yesterday.
passive_voice.e: Bức thư được gửi hôm qua → bị động quá khứ đơn: was + V3.
w: chủ động, thư không tự gửi

passive_voice.q: The room ____ right now, so please wait outside.
passive_voice.e: Đang được dọn ngay lúc này → bị động tiếp diễn: is being + V3.
w: chủ động, phòng không tự dọn

passive_voice.q: All the tickets ____ already. You're too late.
passive_voice.e: Vé "được bán" (bị động) + "already", kết quả còn ở hiện tại (bạn đến muộn) → bị động hiện tại hoàn thành. "have sold" là chủ động (vé không tự bán); "were sell" sai dạng V3.
w: chủ động, vé không tự bán
chủ động tiếp diễn, sai nghĩa

passive_voice.q: The report must ____ by Friday.
passive_voice.e: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu: modal + be + V3.
w: chủ động, báo cáo không tự xong
sau modal cần V nguyên mẫu
tiếp diễn chủ động, sai nghĩa

passive_voice.q: My bike ____ last night.
passive_voice.e: Xe bị lấy cắp (không cần nêu ai làm) → was stolen.
passive_voice.r: was + V3 (không cần "by" khi không rõ tác nhân)
w: chủ động, xe không tự lấy cắp

passive_voice.q: Breakfast ____ from 6 to 10 a.m. in the hotel restaurant.
passive_voice.e: Bữa sáng "được phục vụ" → bị động hiện tại đơn.
w: chủ động, bữa sáng không tự phục vụ

passive_voice.q: The meeting ____ until next Monday.
passive_voice.e: Cuộc họp "bị hoãn" (vừa xảy ra, ảnh hưởng hiện tại) → has been + V3.
w: thiếu trợ động từ, cuộc họp không tự hoãn
✓ bị động hiện tại hoàn thành
chủ động, cuộc họp không tự hoãn

passive_voice.q: This song ____ by a 16-year-old girl.
passive_voice.e: Bài hát "được viết bởi" → bị động quá khứ: was written by.
w: chủ động tiếp diễn, sai nghĩa

passive_voice.q: The documents ____ before the manager arrived.
passive_voice.e: Ký xong TRƯỚC khi quản lý đến (mốc quá khứ) → bị động quá khứ hoàn thành.
w: chủ động tiếp diễn, sai nghĩa
hiện tại hoàn thành, không hợp mốc quá khứ
chủ động, giấy không tự ký

passive_voice.q: Are cars ____ in this factory?
passive_voice.e: Câu hỏi bị động: Are + S + V3?

passive_voice.q: The package (A) was sent (B) yesterday, but it (C) was (D) deliver to the wrong address.
passive_voice.e: Bị động cần V3: "was delivered".

passive_voice.q: The window (A) was broke (B) by (C) the strong wind (D) last night.
passive_voice.e: Bị động cần V3: "was broken". "broke" là V2 (quá khứ), không dùng sau "was".

passive_voice.q: This room ____ every morning.
passive_voice.e: Căn phòng "được dọn" (không tự dọn) và việc lặp lại mỗi sáng → bị động hiện tại đơn: is + V3.
w: chủ động, phòng không tự dọn

passive_voice.q: Many films ____ in this studio in the 1990s.
passive_voice.e: Phim "được làm" vào thập niên 1990 → bị động quá khứ; "films" số nhiều → were.

passive_voice.q: The results ____ on the website tomorrow morning.
passive_voice.e: Kết quả "được đăng" (bị động) vào sáng mai → bị động tương lai: will be + V3.
w: chủ động, kết quả không tự đăng

passive_voice.q: A new hospital ____ in our town at the moment.
passive_voice.e: "at the moment" (lúc này) + bệnh viện "được xây" → bị động tiếp diễn: is being + V3.
w: chủ động, bệnh viện không tự xây

passive_voice.q: I ____ to the party, so I stayed at home.
passive_voice.e: "Tôi không được mời" → bị động quá khứ phủ định: wasn't + V3.
w: chủ động: tôi không mời ai

passive_voice.q: The tickets can ____ online or at the station.
passive_voice.e: Vé "được mua" → sau động từ khuyết thiếu (can) dùng be + V3.
w: chủ động, vé không tự mua
sau modal cần V nguyên mẫu

passive_voice.q: She hates ____ what to do by her older brother.
passive_voice.e: "hate + V-ing"; cô ấy "bị bảo" (có "by her older brother") → V-ing bị động: being + V3.
w: chủ động: cô ấy bảo người khác

passive_voice.q: The suspect is said ____ the country last week.
passive_voice.e: "be said to have V3" = được cho là ĐÃ làm (việc trong quá khứ, "last week").
passive_voice.r: S + be said + to have V3 (việc đã qua)
w: to V chỉ cùng lúc, không hợp "last week"
✓ to have V3 = việc đã xảy ra
phải là "It is said that he left"

passive_voice.q: My phone (A) was repair (B) by a technician (C) in the shop (D) next door.
passive_voice.e: Câu bị động cần V3: "was repaired".

passive_voice.q: These photos (A) were (B) took (C) by my father (D) in 1985.
passive_voice.e: Sau "were" của câu bị động cần V3 "taken"; "took" là V2 (quá khứ đơn).

passive_voice.q: The email (A) has (B) already (C) been send (D) to all customers.
passive_voice.e: Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành: has been + V3 → "been sent".

passive_voice.q: Our flight (A) was (B) delayed because the (C) runway (D) was cleaning.
passive_voice.e: Đường băng không tự dọn mà "đang được dọn" → bị động quá khứ tiếp diễn: "was being cleaned".

passive_voice.q: Someone stole my wallet on the bus.
o: My wallet was stolen on the bus.
My wallet stole on the bus.
My wallet has stolen someone on the bus.
Someone's wallet was stolen by me on the bus.
passive_voice.e: Chuyển sang bị động: tân ngữ "my wallet" lên làm chủ ngữ + was + V3. Không cần "by someone" vì không rõ ai làm.
passive_voice.r: S + V2 + O → O + was/were + V3
w: thiếu "was", ví không tự lấy cắp

passive_voice.q: They will announce the winners tonight.
o: The winners will be announced tonight.
The winners were announced last night.
The winners will have announced them tonight.
passive_voice.e: Bị động tương lai: will be + V3. Giữ nguyên thời gian "tonight".

passive_voice.q: People believe that the castle is 800 years old.
o: The castle is believed to be 800 years old.
The castle believes to be 800 years old.
The castle is believed being 800 years old.
People are believed that the castle is 800 years old.
passive_voice.e: "People believe that S + V" → "S + is believed + to V" (người ta tin rằng …).
passive_voice.r: It is believed that … = S + be believed + to V
w: chủ động, lâu đài không biết tin

passive_voice.q: The chef is preparing the meal now.
o: The meal is being prepared by the chef now.
The meal is preparing by the chef now.
The meal has prepared the chef now.
The chef is being prepared the meal now.
passive_voice.e: Hiện tại tiếp diễn chủ động → bị động: is being + V3.

passive_voice.q: This bridge ____ in 1890.
passive_voice.e: Bị động quá khứ đơn: was + V3.

passive_voice.q: Millions of emails ____ every day.
passive_voice.e: Email "được gửi" → bị động hiện tại đơn: are + V3.

passive_voice.q: The results ____ tomorrow morning.
passive_voice.e: Bị động tương lai: will be + V3.

passive_voice.q: My bike ____ — I have to walk to work now.
passive_voice.e: Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành: has been + V3.

passive_voice.q: The room ____ at the moment, so you can't go in.
passive_voice.e: Bị động tiếp diễn: is being + V3.

passive_voice.q: The letter must ____ by Friday.
passive_voice.e: Bị động với modal: modal + be + V3.

passive_voice.q: By the time we arrived, all the tickets ____.
passive_voice.e: Bị động quá khứ hoàn thành.

passive_voice.q: The new hospital ____ at the moment; it should open next year.
passive_voice.e: Bị động tiếp diễn.

passive_voice.q: I hate ____ what to do.
passive_voice.e: "hate + being V3" = ghét bị (người khác) bảo.

passive_voice.q: The flight ____ because of the storm, so we're staying in a hotel tonight.
passive_voice.e: Chuyến bay "bị huỷ" (kết quả còn tới giờ) → bị động hiện tại hoàn thành.

passive_voice.q: Who ____ the Mona Lisa painted by?
passive_voice.e: Câu hỏi bị động: "Who was … painted by?".

passive_voice.q: The suspect is believed ____ the country.
passive_voice.e: "be believed to have V3" = được cho là đã (trước đó).

passive_voice.q: She expects ____ for the position.
passive_voice.e: "expect to be V3" = mong được chọn.

passive_voice.q: The proposal is ____ discussed at next week's meeting.
passive_voice.e: "be to be V3" = sẽ được (theo kế hoạch, trang trọng).

passive_voice.q: Having ____ twice, the athlete was disqualified.
passive_voice.e: Phân từ hoàn thành bị động: "Having been V3".

passive_voice.q: The window (A) was (B) broke (C) by (D) a ball.
passive_voice.e: Bị động: was + V3 "broken".

passive_voice.q: The cakes (A) are (B) baking (C) every morning (D) by my aunt.
passive_voice.e: Bánh được nướng → bị động "are baked".

passive_voice.q: The car (A) has (B) been (C) repair (D) twice this month.
passive_voice.e: Bị động: has been + V3 → "repaired".

passive_voice.q: The report (A) should (B) be (C) finish (D) before the deadline.
passive_voice.e: modal + be + V3 → "finished".

passive_voice.q: Someone has stolen my wallet.
passive_voice.e: Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành.

passive_voice.q: They are building a new school in our town.
o: A new school is being built in our town.
A new school is built in our town.
A new school is building in our town.
A new school has being built in our town.
passive_voice.e: Bị động tiếp diễn.

passive_voice.q: People should not leave bags unattended.
o: Bags should not be left unattended.
Bags should not be leave unattended.
Bags should be not left unattended.
passive_voice.e: modal + be + V3.

passive_voice.q: The windows ____ every month by a cleaning company.
passive_voice.e: Cửa sổ ĐƯỢC lau, việc định kỳ → bị động hiện tại đơn.

passive_voice.q: The results ____ next week.
passive_voice.e: Kết quả ĐƯỢC công bố, tương lai → will be + V3.

passive_voice.q: The road ____ at the moment, so expect delays.
passive_voice.e: Đang được sửa → bị động tiếp diễn: is being + V3.

passive_voice.q: Three people ____ in the accident last night.
passive_voice.e: Bị thương (bị động) + "last night" → were injured.
w: chủ động = làm người khác bị thương
hoàn thành không đi với "last night"

passive_voice.q: The new library (A) was (B) open (C) by the mayor (D) last Saturday.
passive_voice.e: Bị động cần V3 → "opened".

conditionals.q: If you heat ice, it ____.
conditionals.e: Câu điều kiện loại 0 (sự thật hiển nhiên): If + hiện tại, hiện tại → "melts". "would melt" là loại 2, không hợp với "heat" ở hiện tại.
w: thiếu "is", V-ing không đứng một mình
quá khứ, sai với sự thật chung
loại 2, không hợp vế "If you heat"

conditionals.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ____ the picnic.
conditionals.e: Loại 1 (có thể xảy ra ở tương lai): If + hiện tại đơn, will + V.
w: loại 2, vế If ở hiện tại

conditionals.q: If I ____ rich, I would travel around the world.
conditionals.e: Loại 2 (không có thật ở hiện tại): If + V2 (be → were), would + V.

conditionals.q: If she had studied harder, she ____ the exam.
conditionals.e: Loại 3 (không có thật trong quá khứ): If + had V3, would have V3.
conditionals.r: Loại 3: If + had V3, would have V3

conditionals.q: Unless you hurry, you ____ the train.
conditionals.e: "Unless" = If … not → "Nếu bạn không nhanh lên, bạn sẽ lỡ tàu".
w: loại 2, vế đầu là hiện tại

conditionals.q: If I had taken that job, I ____ in London now.
conditionals.e: Điều kiện hỗn hợp: quá khứ (had taken) → kết quả hiện tại (now): would + V.
conditionals.r: Hỗn hợp: If + had V3, would + V (now)
w: kết quả quá khứ, không hợp "now"
✓ hỗn hợp: kết quả ở hiện tại
quá khứ đơn, sai cấu trúc

conditionals.q: What would you do if you ____ a million dollars?
conditionals.e: Loại 2 → If + V2.

conditionals.q: If I ____ you, I would apologize to her.
conditionals.e: Lời khuyên: If I were you, …

conditionals.q: ____ I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
conditionals.e: Đảo ngữ loại 3: Had + S + V3 = If + S + had V3.
conditionals.r: Had + S + V3, would have V3

conditionals.q: ____ you need any help, please call me.
conditionals.e: Đảo ngữ loại 1 trang trọng: Should + S + V = If + S + V.

conditionals.q: We will go to the beach as long as it ____ sunny.
conditionals.e: "as long as" (miễn là) + hiện tại đơn khi nói về tương lai.
conditionals.r: as long as / provided that + hiện tại đơn
w: không dùng will sau "as long as"
✓ hiện tại đơn chỉ tương lai

conditionals.q: If he ____ the alarm, he wouldn't have been late.
conditionals.e: Loại 3: If + had V3.
w: loại 2, vế sau là "wouldn't have been"

conditionals.q: I (A) will help you (B) tomorrow if I (C) will have (D) time.
conditionals.e: Mệnh đề If của loại 1 dùng hiện tại đơn: "If I have time…".
conditionals.r: If + hiện tại đơn (không dùng will)

conditionals.q: If she (A) would know the answer, she (B) would tell (C) us (D) right away.
conditionals.e: Loại 2: mệnh đề If dùng quá khứ đơn "If she knew…", không dùng "would" trong mệnh đề If.
conditionals.r: Loại 2: If + V2, would + V (không dùng would sau if)

conditionals.q: If you press this button, the machine ____.
conditionals.e: Loại 0 (điều luôn đúng): If + hiện tại, hiện tại đơn. "the machine" số ít → stops.
w: loại 2, vế If ở hiện tại

conditionals.q: If you don't leave now, you ____ late for school.
conditionals.e: Loại 1 (việc có thể xảy ra): If + hiện tại đơn, will + V.
w: loại 2, vế If ở hiện tại

conditionals.q: If we ____ a car, we could visit the mountains more often.
conditionals.e: Loại 2 (không có thật ở hiện tại: chúng tôi không có xe) → If + V2, could / would + V.
w: loại 3, vế sau không có "have V3"

conditionals.q: If they had booked earlier, they ____ better seats.
conditionals.e: Loại 3 (việc quá khứ không có thật): If + had V3, would have + V3.
conditionals.r: Loại 3: If + had V3, would have V3

conditionals.q: I'll lend you my bike ____ you bring it back by six.
conditionals.e: "as long as" = miễn là. Nghĩa: tôi cho mượn, miễn là bạn trả trước 6 giờ.

conditionals.q: If she hadn't missed the bus, she ____ here with us now.
conditionals.e: Hỗn hợp: điều kiện quá khứ (hadn't missed) → kết quả ở hiện tại ("now") → would + V.
conditionals.r: Hỗn hợp: If + had V3, would + V (now)
w: kết quả quá khứ, không hợp "now"

conditionals.q: ____ you to win the lottery, what would you buy?
conditionals.e: "Were + S + to V" = "If + S + were to V": giả định khó xảy ra (loại 2, đảo ngữ).
conditionals.r: Were + S + to V, would + V
w: "If you to win" thiếu động từ
✓ Were + S + to V (đảo ngữ loại 2)

conditionals.q: If he (A) will call (B) me tonight, I (C) will tell him (D) the news.
conditionals.e: Mệnh đề If loại 1 dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng will: "If he calls".
conditionals.r: If + hiện tại đơn (không dùng will)

conditionals.q: If I (A) had (B) knew about the party, I (C) would have (D) come.
conditionals.e: Loại 3: had + V3 → "had known" ("knew" là V2).

conditionals.q: We (A) can go (B) to the beach tomorrow if it (C) won't rain (D) all day.
conditionals.e: Mệnh đề If nói về tương lai vẫn dùng hiện tại đơn: "if it doesn't rain".
conditionals.r: If + hiện tại đơn (không dùng will)

conditionals.q: If my grandmother (A) were (B) still alive, she (C) would (D) loves this film.
conditionals.e: Sau "would" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: "would love".

conditionals.q: I don't have enough money, so I can't buy a new phone.
o: If I had enough money, I could buy a new phone.
If I have enough money, I could buy a new phone.
If I had had enough money, I can buy a new phone.
If I didn't have enough money, I could buy a new phone.
conditionals.e: Sự thật ở hiện tại (không có tiền) → đặt giả thiết ngược lại bằng loại 2: If + V2, could + V.
w: vế If phải ở quá khứ

conditionals.q: You must hurry, or you will miss the bus.
o: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you hurry, you will miss the bus.
Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you didn't hurry, you will miss the bus.
conditionals.e: "or" ở đây = "nếu không thì" → If you don't …, you will …

conditionals.q: She didn't study, so she failed the test.
o: If she had studied, she wouldn't have failed the test.
If she studied, she wouldn't fail the test.
If she had studied, she would have failed the test.
If she hadn't studied, she wouldn't have failed the test.
conditionals.e: Việc quá khứ, giả thiết ngược lại → loại 3; đổi khẳng định ↔ phủ định (didn't study → had studied).

conditionals.q: If you should see Anna, please give her this note.
o: Should you see Anna, please give her this note.
Had you seen Anna, please give her this note.
Were you see Anna, please give her this note.
Should you saw Anna, please give her this note.
conditionals.e: Đảo ngữ: bỏ "If", đưa "Should" lên đầu câu: Should + S + V.
conditionals.r: If S should V = Should S V
w: sau should cần V nguyên mẫu

conditionals.q: If you mix red and yellow, you ____ orange.
conditionals.e: Sự thật luôn đúng → điều kiện loại 0: If + hiện tại đơn, hiện tại đơn.

conditionals.q: If it ____ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
conditionals.e: Loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V.

conditionals.q: If I ____ you, I would accept the offer.
conditionals.e: Lời khuyên giả định → loại 2 "If I were you".
conditionals.r: If I were you, I would…
w: loại 1 không hợp lời khuyên giả định

conditionals.q: If I ____ the answer, I would tell you, but I don't.
conditionals.e: Trái thực tế hiện tại ("but I don't") → loại 2.

conditionals.q: If she had left earlier, she ____ the train.
conditionals.e: Loại 3: If + had V3, would have V3.

conditionals.q: If I hadn't stayed up so late, I ____ so tired now.
conditionals.e: Hỗn hợp: quá khứ (hadn't stayed up) → kết quả hiện tại ("now").
conditionals.r: If + had V3, would + V (hiện tại)

conditionals.q: If he were more organised, he ____ the deadline last week.
conditionals.e: Hỗn hợp: tính cách hiện tại (were) → kết quả quá khứ ("last week").
conditionals.r: If + V2 (hiện tại), would have V3 (quá khứ)

conditionals.q: We ____ lost if we had taken the map.
conditionals.e: Loại 3 (had taken).

conditionals.q: If you ____ Tom, tell him I'm looking for him.
conditionals.e: Loại 1 + mệnh lệnh: If + hiện tại đơn, V (mệnh lệnh).

conditionals.q: If the weather ____ nicer, we could have eaten outside.
conditionals.e: "could have eaten" → loại 3 → "had been".

conditionals.q: I'd have called you if I ____ your number.
conditionals.e: Loại 3.

conditionals.q: ____ I known you were coming, I'd have baked a cake.
conditionals.e: Đảo ngữ loại 3: "Had + S + V3" thay cho "If I had known".
conditionals.r: Had + S + V3 = If + had V3

conditionals.q: ____ you require any further information, please contact us.
conditionals.e: Đảo ngữ loại 1 trang trọng: "Should you require…" = If you require…

conditionals.q: ____ it not been for your help, I would have failed.
conditionals.e: "Had it not been for + N" = nếu không có… (loại 3).
conditionals.r: Had it not been for = If it hadn't been for
w: "Were it not for" là loại 2 (không có "been")

conditionals.q: ____ it not for the rain, we would go hiking today.
conditionals.e: "Were it not for + N" = nếu không có… (loại 2, hiện tại).
conditionals.r: Were it not for = If it weren't for

conditionals.q: If I (A) will have (B) time, I (C) will help you (D) with it.
conditionals.e: Không dùng "will" trong mệnh đề if loại 1 → "have".

conditionals.q: If she (A) would have studied, she (B) would have (C) passed (D) the exam.
conditionals.e: Mệnh đề if loại 3 → "had studied".

conditionals.q: If I (A) was (B) taller, I (C) would (D) joined the basketball team.
conditionals.e: Loại 2: "would + V nguyên mẫu" → "would join".

conditionals.q: (A) Had (B) we (C) knew about the strike, we (D) would have driven.
conditionals.e: Đảo ngữ "Had + S + V3" → "known".

conditionals.q: I don't have a car, so I can't drive you home.
o: If I had a car, I could drive you home.
If I have a car, I could drive you home.
If I had a car, I can drive you home.
If I would have a car, I could drive you home.
conditionals.e: Trái hiện tại → loại 2.

conditionals.q: He didn't take the medicine, so he is still ill.
o: If he had taken the medicine, he wouldn't be ill now.
If he took the medicine, he wouldn't be ill now.
If he had taken the medicine, he wouldn't have been ill now.
If he takes the medicine, he won't be ill now.
conditionals.e: Quá khứ → kết quả hiện tại → hỗn hợp.

conditionals.q: If you need any help, just call me.
o: Should you need any help, just call me.
Should you needed any help, just call me.
Were you need any help, just call me.
Had you need any help, just call me.
conditionals.e: Đảo ngữ loại 1: "Should + S + V".

conditionals.q: If I ____ you, I'd apologise.
conditionals.e: Lời khuyên với điều kiện loại 2: If I were you.

conditionals.q: If she ____ earlier, she wouldn't have missed the bus.
conditionals.e: Loại 3: If + had V3, would have V3.
conditionals.r: If + had V3 → would have V3

conditionals.q: If you mix blue and yellow, you ____ green.
conditionals.e: Loại 0 (sự thật luôn đúng): If + hiện tại, hiện tại.

conditionals.q: If she hadn't missed her flight, she ____ in Paris right now.
conditionals.e: Hỗn hợp: điều kiện quá khứ (hadn't missed) → kết quả hiện tại (right now) → would + V.
w: kết quả quá khứ, mâu thuẫn "right now"

conditionals.q: If I ____ more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
conditionals.e: Loại 2 (giả định hiện tại): If + V2, would + V.

conditionals.q: If it (A) will rain tomorrow, (B) the match (C) will be (D) cancelled.
conditionals.e: Mệnh đề "if" loại 1 dùng hiện tại đơn → "rains tomorrow".
conditionals.r: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V

relative_clauses.q: The woman ____ lives next door is a doctor.
relative_clauses.e: Thay cho người, làm chủ ngữ → "who".
w: whose cần danh từ theo sau

relative_clauses.q: The book ____ I borrowed from you is very interesting.
relative_clauses.e: Thay cho vật → "which" (hoặc that).
w: whose cần danh từ theo sau

relative_clauses.q: The man ____ car was stolen called the police.
relative_clauses.e: Sở hữu ("xe của người đàn ông") → "whose".

relative_clauses.q: This is the hotel ____ we stayed last summer.
relative_clauses.e: Chỉ nơi chốn (we stayed IN the hotel) → "where".

relative_clauses.q: I'll never forget the day ____ I met you.
relative_clauses.e: Chỉ thời gian → "when".

relative_clauses.q: The person to ____ you should speak is Mr. Lee.
relative_clauses.e: Sau giới từ "to" chỉ người → "whom" (không dùng who / that sau giới từ).
w: không dùng who sau giới từ
không dùng that sau giới từ

relative_clauses.q: My brother, ____ lives in Hanoi, is an engineer.
relative_clauses.e: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) → không dùng "that"; chỉ người làm chủ ngữ → "who".
w: không dùng that sau dấu phẩy

relative_clauses.q: She passed the exam, ____ surprised everyone.
relative_clauses.e: "which" thay cho cả mệnh đề phía trước ("việc cô ấy đậu").
relative_clauses.r: , which = thay cho cả mệnh đề
w: không dùng that sau dấu phẩy
what không thay cho mệnh đề

relative_clauses.q: Is this the reason ____ you were late?
relative_clauses.e: Chỉ lý do → "why".

relative_clauses.q: Everything ____ she said was true.
relative_clauses.e: Sau "everything / all / nothing" thường dùng "that". "what" không đứng sau danh từ.
w: what không đứng sau danh từ

relative_clauses.q: The company, ____ headquarters are in Seoul, has opened a branch in Vietnam.
relative_clauses.e: Sở hữu ("trụ sở của công ty") → "whose".
w: không dùng that sau dấu phẩy

relative_clauses.q: The students ____ passed the test will receive a certificate.
relative_clauses.e: Chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ của "passed" → "who".

relative_clauses.q: This is the house (A) where my grandfather (B) built (C) with his own hands (D) in 1960.
relative_clauses.e: "built" cần tân ngữ, và tân ngữ chính là "the house" → dùng "which / that", không dùng "where".
relative_clauses.r: where = nơi chốn (in which); which / that = làm tân ngữ

relative_clauses.q: The man (A) who (B) he helped me (C) yesterday is (D) my neighbor.
relative_clauses.e: "who" đã làm chủ ngữ → bỏ "he": "who helped me".
relative_clauses.r: Không lặp lại chủ ngữ sau who / which

relative_clauses.q: I have a friend ____ speaks four languages.
relative_clauses.e: Thay cho người ("a friend") và làm chủ ngữ của "speaks" → who.
w: whose cần danh từ theo sau

relative_clauses.q: This is the phone ____ I bought last week.
relative_clauses.e: Thay cho vật ("the phone") làm tân ngữ của "bought" → that / which.
w: whose cần danh từ theo sau

relative_clauses.q: Do you know the girl ____ bag is on the chair?
relative_clauses.e: Sở hữu: "cái túi CỦA cô gái" → whose + danh từ.

relative_clauses.q: We visited the village ____ my father grew up.
relative_clauses.e: "my father grew up IN the village" → where (= in which).

relative_clauses.q: The doctor ____ I saw yesterday was very kind.
relative_clauses.e: Thay cho người làm tân ngữ của "saw" → whom (cũng có thể dùng who / that).

relative_clauses.q: The old town, ____ is famous for its narrow streets, attracts many visitors.
relative_clauses.e: Mệnh đề có dấu phẩy, thay cho vật và làm chủ ngữ của "is" → which. Không dùng "that" sau dấu phẩy.
w: không dùng that sau dấu phẩy
where cần S + V phía sau
what không thay cho danh từ

relative_clauses.q: I have two sisters, both of ____ live abroad.
relative_clauses.e: Sau giới từ "of" chỉ người → whom: "both of whom" (cả hai người đó).
relative_clauses.r: some / both / all of + whom (người) / which (vật)
w: không dùng who sau giới từ

relative_clauses.q: The hotel ____ we stayed in was close to the beach.
relative_clauses.e: Đã có giới từ "in" ở cuối → dùng which / that. "where" đã mang nghĩa "in which" nên sẽ thừa "in".

relative_clauses.q: The (A) man which (B) lives (C) next door (D) is a pilot.
relative_clauses.e: Chỉ người → dùng "who", không dùng "which": "the man who lives …".

relative_clauses.q: The book (A) that (B) you lent it (C) to me (D) was great.
relative_clauses.e: "that" đã thay cho "the book" (tân ngữ) → bỏ "it": "that you lent to me".
relative_clauses.r: Không lặp tân ngữ sau that / which

relative_clauses.q: This is the restaurant (A) where (B) we ate (C) at it (D) last year.
relative_clauses.e: "where" = "at which" → thêm "at it" là thừa.

relative_clauses.q: Anna, (A) who (B) is my neighbor, (C) has a dog (D) that it barks all night.
relative_clauses.e: "that" đã làm chủ ngữ của "barks" → bỏ "it": "a dog that barks".
relative_clauses.r: Không lặp chủ ngữ sau who / which / that

relative_clauses.q: The man is a famous chef. He is sitting by the window.
o: The man who is sitting by the window is a famous chef.
The man which is sitting by the window is a famous chef.
The man who he is sitting by the window is a famous chef.
The man is sitting by the window who is a famous chef.
relative_clauses.e: Gộp 2 câu bằng "who" (thay cho "He", chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ); không lặp lại "he".
w: mệnh đề quan hệ sai vị trí

relative_clauses.q: I bought a lamp. Its light is very soft.
o: I bought a lamp whose light is very soft.
I bought a lamp which light is very soft.
I bought a lamp who its light is very soft.
I bought a lamp that its light is very soft.
relative_clauses.e: "Its light" (ánh sáng của nó) → whose + danh từ. "whose" dùng cho cả người và vật.

relative_clauses.q: The house where I grew up has been sold.
o: The house in which I grew up has been sold.
The house which I grew up has been sold.
The house in where I grew up has been sold.
The house that I grew up there has been sold.
relative_clauses.e: "where" = "in which" (nơi mà).

relative_clauses.q: Do you remember the day? We first met on that day.
o: Do you remember the day when we first met?
Do you remember the day where we first met?
Do you remember the day which we first met?
Do you remember the day when we first met on it?
relative_clauses.e: Chỉ thời gian → when (= on which).

relative_clauses.q: The engineer ____ designed this bridge won an award.
relative_clauses.e: Chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ → "who".

relative_clauses.q: That's the hotel ____ we stayed last summer.
relative_clauses.e: Nơi chốn + mệnh đề đủ thành phần → "where".
w: "which" cần giới từ (which we stayed at)

relative_clauses.q: I have a friend ____ father is a pilot.
relative_clauses.e: Sở hữu → "whose + N".

relative_clauses.q: Do you remember the day ____ we first met?
relative_clauses.e: Thời gian → "when".

relative_clauses.q: My brother, ____ lives in Canada, is visiting next week.
relative_clauses.e: Mệnh đề không xác định (có dấu phẩy) → không dùng "that".

relative_clauses.q: The report, ____ was published yesterday, has caused a lot of debate.
relative_clauses.e: Không xác định, chỉ vật → "which".

relative_clauses.q: He failed the test, ____ surprised everyone.
relative_clauses.e: "which" thay cho cả mệnh đề trước.

relative_clauses.q: The man to ____ I spoke was very helpful.
relative_clauses.e: Sau giới từ → "whom" (người).

relative_clauses.q: I've got three brothers, all of ____ are older than me.
relative_clauses.e: "all / some / most of + whom" (người).
w: "them" tạo 2 mệnh đề độc lập sai

relative_clauses.q: She told me the reason ____ she quit.
relative_clauses.e: "the reason why".

relative_clauses.q: This is ____ I've been looking for.
relative_clauses.e: "what" = the thing that (không có tiền ngữ).

relative_clauses.q: The company, ____ headquarters are in Tokyo, employs 5,000 people.
relative_clauses.e: Sở hữu → "whose" (dùng được cho vật).

relative_clauses.q: The extent to ____ the policy has succeeded is unclear.
relative_clauses.e: "the extent to which".

relative_clauses.q: He spoke for an hour, during ____ time nobody moved.
relative_clauses.e: "which" làm từ hạn định: "during which time".

relative_clauses.q: Several solutions were proposed, none of ____ was acceptable.
relative_clauses.e: "none of which".

relative_clauses.q: The car (A) who (B) is parked (C) outside (D) is mine.
relative_clauses.e: Vật → "which / that".

relative_clauses.q: Paris, (A) that (B) is the capital of France, (C) is famous (D) for its museums.
relative_clauses.e: Mệnh đề không xác định → "which".

relative_clauses.q: The people (A) who (B) I met (C) them at the party (D) were friendly.
relative_clauses.e: Thừa tân ngữ "them" (đại từ quan hệ đã thay).

relative_clauses.q: This is the house (A) which (B) my grandfather (C) lived (D) for fifty years.
relative_clauses.e: Nơi chốn, mệnh đề không có giới từ → "where" (hoặc "which … lived in").

relative_clauses.q: I met a girl. Her father is a famous actor.
o: I met a girl whose father is a famous actor.
I met a girl who father is a famous actor.
I met a girl which father is a famous actor.
I met a girl whose her father is a famous actor.
relative_clauses.e: Sở hữu → whose.

relative_clauses.q: She won the prize. This made her parents proud.
o: She won the prize, which made her parents proud.
She won the prize, that made her parents proud.
She won the prize, what made her parents proud.
She won the prize which it made her parents proud.
relative_clauses.e: "which" thay cả mệnh đề.

relative_clauses.q: I have two sisters. Both of them are teachers.
o: I have two sisters, both of whom are teachers.
I have two sisters, both of who are teachers.
I have two sisters, both of them who are teachers.
I have two sisters, both whom are teachers.
relative_clauses.e: "both of whom".

relative_clauses.q: Customers ____ spend over $100 receive a free gift bag.
relative_clauses.e: Thay cho người (customers), làm chủ ngữ → who.

relative_clauses.q: That's the restaurant ____ we had our first date.
relative_clauses.e: Thay cho nơi chốn, mệnh đề sau đủ thành phần → where.

relative_clauses.q: The student ____ essay won the prize is only sixteen.
relative_clauses.e: Sở hữu: bài luận CỦA học sinh → whose + danh từ.

relative_clauses.q: The colleague with ____ I share an office is moving to Berlin.
relative_clauses.e: Sau giới từ "with", thay cho người → whom.

relative_clauses.q: The book (A) that I (B) borrowed it (C) from the library (D) is overdue.
relative_clauses.e: "that" đã thay cho "the book" → bỏ "it": "borrowed".
relative_clauses.r: Không lặp lại tân ngữ trong mệnh đề quan hệ

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I enjoy ____ to music in my free time.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest + V-ing
w: enjoy không đi với to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: She decided ____ a new car.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: decide, plan, hope, want, agree + to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: Would you mind ____ the window?
w: mind không đi với to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: He promised ____ me with my homework.
I was walking home when I stopped ____ to an old friend.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "stop + to V" = dừng lại ĐỂ làm việc khác (dừng lại để nói chuyện). "stop + V-ing" = thôi không làm việc đang làm.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: stop to V (dừng để làm) ≠ stop V-ing (thôi làm)
w: stop V-ing = thôi làm, sai nghĩa
✓ stop to V = dừng để làm

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: Remember ____ the lights before you leave.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "remember + to V" = nhớ (phải) làm việc chưa làm.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: remember to V (việc sắp làm) ≠ remember V-ing (đã làm)

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I remember ____ this movie when I was a child.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: Nhớ việc đã làm trong quá khứ → remember + V-ing.
w: to V = việc sắp làm, sai nghĩa

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: She is good at ____ problems.
w: sau giới từ không dùng to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: They avoided ____ about politics at dinner.
w: avoid không đi với to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: It's too cold ____ swimming today.
I'm looking forward to ____ you next week.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "look forward to" — "to" là giới từ → V-ing.

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: My parents let me ____ out late on weekends.
w: let không đi với to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: We regret ____ you that your application was unsuccessful.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "regret to V" = rất tiếc phải (thông báo…). "regret V-ing" = hối hận đã làm.
w: regret V-ing = hối hận đã làm
✓ regret to V = tiếc phải báo

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: After the (A) meeting, she (B) suggested (C) to go (D) to a new restaurant.
I (A) can't afford (B) buying a (C) new car (D) this year.
I want ____ a doctor when I grow up.
Please stop ____ so much noise. I'm trying to sleep.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "stop + V-ing" = ngừng việc đang làm (đừng ồn nữa).
w: stop to V = dừng lại để làm, sai nghĩa

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: He keeps ____ the same mistake again and again.
w: keep không đi với to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: We hope ____ you again soon.
Have you finished ____ the report yet?
w: finish không đi với to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: She went to the library ____ for her exam.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: Nói mục đích (đi thư viện ĐỂ học) → to V.

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: Your hair is too long. It needs ____.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "need + V-ing" mang nghĩa bị động = cần được làm (= needs to be cut).
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: need V-ing = need to be V3

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I'll never forget ____ the ocean for the first time.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "forget + V-ing" = (không) quên việc ĐÃ làm. "never forget seeing" = mãi nhớ lần đã thấy.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: forget V-ing (đã làm) ≠ forget to V (quên chưa làm)
w: to V = quên chưa làm, sai nghĩa

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I (A) enjoy to read (B) books (C) before (D) going to bed.
She (A) refused (B) answering (C) any questions (D) from reporters.
My boss (A) made (B) me (C) to work (D) late on Friday.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "make + người + V nguyên mẫu (không to)": "made me work".

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: They (A) are (B) interested (C) in (D) learn Japanese.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: Sau giới từ "in" dùng V-ing: "interested in learning".

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: It is difficult to find a cheap apartment in this city.
o: Finding a cheap apartment in this city is difficult.
Find a cheap apartment in this city is difficult.
To finding a cheap apartment in this city is difficult.
It is difficult finding to a cheap apartment in this city.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: V-ing có thể làm chủ ngữ: "Finding … is difficult" = "It is difficult to find …".
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: It is adj to V = V-ing … is adj
w: V nguyên mẫu không làm chủ ngữ

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I'm sorry that I was rude to you yesterday.
o: I regret being rude to you yesterday.
I regret to be rude to you yesterday.
I regret to being rude to you yesterday.
I regret be rude to you yesterday.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: Hối hận về việc ĐÃ làm → regret + V-ing.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: regret V-ing = hối hận đã làm
w: regret to V = tiếc phải báo

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: "Let's go for a walk," said Tom.
o: Tom suggested going for a walk.
Tom suggested to go for a walk.
Tom suggested go for a walk.
Tom suggested us to go for a walk.
w: suggest không đi với to V

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I don't remember that I locked the door.
o: I don't remember locking the door.
I don't remember to lock the door.
I don't remember lock the door.
I don't remember to locking the door.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: Nhớ (hay không nhớ) việc ĐÃ làm → remember + V-ing.
w: to V = nhớ phải làm, sai nghĩa

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I'm thinking of ____ my job.
She agreed ____ me with the move.
Would you mind ____ your bag off the seat?
Students often can't afford ____ in the city centre.
He avoided ____ eye contact with me.
I remember ____ the door, but now it's open!
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: remember V-ing (đã làm) ≠ remember to V (nhớ phải làm)

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: Remember ____ the lights off when you leave.
We stopped ____ a coffee on the way.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "stop to V" = dừng lại để làm.

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: You should stop ____ so much sugar.
We regret ____ that the 9:15 service to Leeds has been cancelled.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "regret to V" = lấy làm tiếc phải thông báo (lời thông báo trang trọng).
w: nghĩa "hối hận đã thông báo", sai

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I regret ____ so rude to her yesterday.
If the printer doesn't work, try ____ it off and on again.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "try V-ing" = thử làm (xem có hiệu quả).

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: It's no use ____ about it now.
We look forward to ____ from you soon.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "look forward to + V-ing" (to là giới từ) — câu cuối thư hay gặp.

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: She pretended ____ asleep.
Missing the train meant ____ for another hour.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: "mean V-ing" = đồng nghĩa với việc phải.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: mean V-ing (kéo theo) ≠ mean to V (định)

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I didn't mean ____ you.
She objected to ____ like a child.
I enjoy (A) to swim (B) in the sea (C) on (D) hot days.
She (A) refused (B) answering (C) any (D) questions.
I'm (A) used to (B) work (C) at night, so (D) I don't mind.
It's dangerous to swim here.
I'm sorry that I missed your party.
o: I regret to miss your party.
I regret to have missing your party.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: Hối hận về quá khứ → "regret V-ing".

gerund_vs_infinitive.q: I enjoy ____ in the mountains.
She refused ____ the contract.
Please remember ____ your passport when you go to the embassy.
gerund_vs_infinitive.e: remember + to V = nhớ (để) làm việc sắp tới.
gerund_vs_infinitive.r: remember to V (việc sắp làm) ≠ remember V-ing (nhớ đã làm)
w: "bringing" = nhớ là đã mang, sai nghĩa

reported_speech.q: Last week, Mai said that she ____ too tired to go out that evening.
reported_speech.e: Tường thuật lùi thì: am/is → was.
reported_speech.r: Lùi thì: hiện tại → quá khứ

reported_speech.q: He told me he ____ to Paris the year before.
reported_speech.e: "the year before" → hành động trước thời điểm nói trong quá khứ → lùi quá khứ đơn thành quá khứ hoàn thành.

reported_speech.q: "I will call you tomorrow," he said last week. → He said he would call me ____.
reported_speech.e: Lời nói từ tuần trước nên "tomorrow" đã qua → đổi thành "the next day / the following day".
w: lời nói tuần trước, "tomorrow" đã qua

reported_speech.q: She asked me where I ____.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi tường thuật: không đảo ngữ, không dùng do / did, lùi thì → "where I lived".
w: không đảo ngữ trong câu tường thuật

reported_speech.q: He asked me ____ I liked Vietnamese food.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi Yes/No tường thuật → if / whether.
w: câu hỏi Yes/No không dùng that

reported_speech.q: The teacher told us ____ talk during the test.
reported_speech.e: Mệnh lệnh phủ định tường thuật: told + O + not to V.

reported_speech.q: "Can you help me?" she asked. → She asked me ____ help her.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi Yes/No tường thuật dùng "if / whether" (không dùng "that"), không đảo ngữ, lùi thì "can" → "could".

reported_speech.q: "We are watching TV," they said. → They said they ____ TV.
reported_speech.e: Hiện tại tiếp diễn → quá khứ tiếp diễn; chủ ngữ "they" → "were" (không phải "was"). "watched" làm mất nghĩa "đang".

reported_speech.q: "I have finished my work," she said. → She said she ____ her work.
reported_speech.e: Hiện tại hoàn thành → lùi thành quá khứ hoàn thành "had finished".

reported_speech.q: He suggested that we ____ a taxi.
reported_speech.e: "suggest that + S + (should) + V nguyên mẫu".

reported_speech.q: "Don't be late," my boss said. → My boss warned me ____ late.
reported_speech.e: warn + O + not to V.
w: warn O không đi với don't

reported_speech.q: Last month she told me that she ____ come to my party, so I didn't expect her.
reported_speech.e: "can't" → "couldn't" khi lùi thì.

reported_speech.q: He (A) asked (B) me where (C) did I put (D) his keys.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi tường thuật không đảo trợ động từ: "where I had put / where I put his keys".

reported_speech.q: She (A) called (B) yesterday and (C) said me (D) that she was quitting.
reported_speech.e: "say" không có tân ngữ người trực tiếp → "told me" hoặc "said (to me)".

reported_speech.q: "I'm very hungry," said Tom. → Tom said that he ____ very hungry.
reported_speech.e: Tường thuật lùi thì: am → was ("he" đi với was).

reported_speech.q: "Where is the station?" the tourist asked. → The tourist asked where the station ____.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi tường thuật: không đảo ngữ (S + V) và lùi thì (is → was).

reported_speech.q: "Please close the door," the teacher said to me. → The teacher asked me ____ the door.
reported_speech.e: Lời yêu cầu tường thuật: ask + người + to V.

reported_speech.q: "I'm going to sell my car," he said. → He said he ____ sell his car.
reported_speech.e: Lùi thì: am going to → was going to.
reported_speech.r: am/is going to → was going to

reported_speech.q: "Did you enjoy the concert?" my friend asked. → My friend asked me if I ____ the concert.
reported_speech.e: Quá khứ đơn lùi thành quá khứ hoàn thành; câu hỏi tường thuật không đảo ngữ.

reported_speech.q: "I saw her yesterday," he told me last month. → He said he had seen her ____.
reported_speech.e: Lời nói từ tháng trước → "yesterday" đổi thành "the day before / the previous day".
w: lời nói đã lâu, phải đổi

reported_speech.q: She ____ me that the meeting had been cancelled.
reported_speech.e: "tell + người + that …". "say" không đi thẳng với tân ngữ người (phải là "said to me").
reported_speech.r: tell sb that / say (to sb) that
w: say không có tân ngữ người

reported_speech.q: He denied ____ the money from the drawer.
reported_speech.e: "deny + V-ing" = chối là đã làm.
w: deny không đi với to V

reported_speech.q: My mother (A) told to me (B) that dinner (C) was (D) ready.
reported_speech.e: "tell" đi thẳng với người, không có "to": "told me".

reported_speech.q: The officer asked (A) us where (B) were we (C) going, and we told him (D) the truth.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi tường thuật không đảo ngữ: "where we were going".

reported_speech.q: Yesterday she told me she (A) was tired and (B) that she (C) will go (D) to bed early.
reported_speech.e: Câu nói đã ở quá khứ (hôm qua) → lùi thì: will → would.

reported_speech.q: The guide (A) told (B) us (C) not (D) touching the paintings.
reported_speech.e: Mệnh lệnh phủ định tường thuật: tell + O + not to V → "not to touch".

reported_speech.q: "I am working on a new project," Lisa said.
o: Lisa said that she was working on a new project.
Lisa said that she is work on a new project.
Lisa said that I was working on a new project.
Lisa told that she was working on a new project.
reported_speech.e: Lùi thì: am working → was working; đổi ngôi: I → she.

reported_speech.q: "Have you ever been to Africa?" she asked me.
o: She asked me if I had ever been to Africa.
She asked me had I ever been to Africa.
She asked me if had I ever been to Africa.
She asked me that I had ever been to Africa.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi Yes/No → asked if + S + V: không đảo ngữ, lùi thì (have been → had been).

reported_speech.q: "Don't touch the oven," Dad said to me.
o: Dad told me not to touch the oven.
Dad told me don't touch the oven.
Dad said me not to touch the oven.
Dad told me to not touching the oven.
reported_speech.e: Mệnh lệnh phủ định → tell + O + not to V.
w: say không có tân ngữ người

reported_speech.q: "I'll help you with your homework tomorrow," my brother said.
o: My brother said he would help me with my homework the next day.
My brother said he will helped me with my homework the next day.
My brother said he would help me with my homework the day before.
My brother said me he would help me with my homework the next day.
reported_speech.e: Đổi đủ 3 thứ: will → would; I → he, you → me; tomorrow → the next day.
reported_speech.r: will → would; tomorrow → the next day
w: ✓ đổi đủ thì, ngôi, thời gian
"the day before" = hôm trước, sai nghĩa
say không có tân ngữ người

reported_speech.q: "I'm tired," she said. → She said that she ____ tired.
reported_speech.e: Lùi thì: am → was (lúc kể, cô ấy không còn nói ở hiện tại).

reported_speech.q: He told me he ____ to Paris the previous summer.
reported_speech.e: "the previous summer" → việc trước lúc kể → quá khứ hoàn thành.

reported_speech.q: He asked us what we ____ for a living.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi tường thuật: không đảo, lùi thì (do → did).

reported_speech.q: The guard told the visitors ____ photos inside the museum.
reported_speech.e: Mệnh lệnh phủ định tường thuật: "tell sb not to V".

reported_speech.q: "Can you help me?" he asked. → He asked me if I ____ help him.
reported_speech.e: Lùi thì: can → could.

reported_speech.q: She said she would see me ____.
reported_speech.e: Đổi trạng từ thời gian: tomorrow → the next day / the following day.

reported_speech.q: He asked me ____ I had ever been to Japan.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi Yes / No tường thuật → if / whether.

reported_speech.q: My boss ____ me to finish the report by Friday.
reported_speech.e: "tell sb to V"; "say" không đi với tân ngữ người trực tiếp.

reported_speech.q: She ____ that she had already paid the bill.
reported_speech.e: "say that…"; "tell" cần tân ngữ người.

reported_speech.q: He apologised for ____ late.
reported_speech.e: "apologise for + V-ing".

reported_speech.q: She suggested ____ a taxi to save time.
reported_speech.e: "suggest + V-ing" (không dùng suggest to V / suggest sb to V).

reported_speech.q: They accused him ____ the money.
reported_speech.e: "accuse sb of V-ing".

reported_speech.q: He denied ____ the window.
reported_speech.e: "deny + V-ing".

reported_speech.q: She warned me ____ the dog — it bites.
reported_speech.e: "warn sb not to V".

reported_speech.q: He insisted on ____ for the meal.
reported_speech.e: "insist on + V-ing".

reported_speech.q: She reminded me ____ the door before leaving.
reported_speech.e: "remind sb to V".

reported_speech.q: The spokesperson declined ____ on the rumours.
reported_speech.e: "decline to V" = từ chối (lịch sự).

reported_speech.q: She (A) asked me (B) where (C) did I (D) work.
reported_speech.e: Câu hỏi tường thuật không đảo → "where I worked".

reported_speech.q: He (A) said (B) me that he (C) was (D) busy.
reported_speech.e: "say" không có tân ngữ người trực tiếp → "told me" hoặc "said (to me)".

reported_speech.q: The doctor (A) advised (B) me (C) stop (D) smoking.
reported_speech.e: "advise sb to V" → "to stop".

reported_speech.q: She (A) suggested (B) to go (C) to the beach (D) on Sunday.
reported_speech.e: "suggest + V-ing" (không dùng suggest to V) → "suggested going".

reported_speech.q: "Don't be late," Mum said to me.
o: Mum told me not to be late.
Mum told me to not late.
Mum said me not to be late.
Mum told me don't be late.
reported_speech.e: Mệnh lệnh phủ định → "tell sb not to V".

reported_speech.q: "I'll call you tomorrow," he said.
o: He said he would call me the next day.
He said he will call me tomorrow.
He said he would call me yesterday.
He told he would call me the next day.
reported_speech.e: Lùi thì will → would, tomorrow → the next day.

reported_speech.q: "It was you who broke the vase!" she said to him.
o: She accused him of breaking the vase.
She accused him to break the vase.
She accused him for breaking the vase.
She accused that he broke the vase.
reported_speech.e: "accuse sb of V-ing".

reported_speech.q: "Shall we go to the cinema?" said Anna.
o: Anna suggested going to the cinema.
Anna suggested to go to the cinema.
Anna suggested us to go to the cinema.
Anna suggested go to the cinema.
reported_speech.e: Gợi ý "Shall we…?" → "suggest + V-ing".

reported_speech.q: She told me that she ____ the job the day before.
reported_speech.e: Tường thuật quá khứ + "the day before" → lùi về had + V3.
reported_speech.r: told + that + had V3 (the day before)
w: không lùi thì, sai với "the day before"

reported_speech.q: He asked me ____ I could help him with his homework.
reported_speech.e: Tường thuật câu hỏi Yes/No → if / whether.

indirect_questions.q: Could you tell me where the station ____?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: S + V (không đảo): "where the station is".
indirect_questions.r: Could you tell me + Wh- + S + V?

indirect_questions.q: Do you know what time the meeting ____?
indirect_questions.e: Không dùng trợ động từ "does" trong câu hỏi gián tiếp → "what time the meeting starts".
indirect_questions.r: Do you know + Wh- + S + V(s)?

indirect_questions.q: I wonder ____ she will come to the party.
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi Yes/No gián tiếp → if / whether.
indirect_questions.r: I wonder if / whether + S + V

indirect_questions.q: Can you tell me how much this jacket ____?
indirect_questions.e: Câu gián tiếp giữ trật tự S + V, không dùng trợ động từ "does": "how much this jacket costs". "cost" (giá) là động từ trạng thái → không chia tiếp diễn.

indirect_questions.q: I'd like to know ____ you are leaving so early.
indirect_questions.e: "why + S + V" không đảo: "why you are leaving".
indirect_questions.r: I'd like to know + Wh- + S + V
w: sai nghĩa, không phải câu hỏi

indirect_questions.q: Do you remember ____ we parked the car?
indirect_questions.e: "where + S + V": "where we parked the car".

indirect_questions.q: Could you tell me ____ the museum opens on Sundays?
indirect_questions.e: Hỏi gián tiếp dạng Yes/No → "if".

indirect_questions.q: Nobody knows who ____ the window.
indirect_questions.e: "who" làm chủ ngữ → giữ nguyên trật tự: "who broke the window".

indirect_questions.q: Can you explain what this word ____?
indirect_questions.e: "what this word means".

indirect_questions.q: I'm not sure ____ to do next.
indirect_questions.e: "what + to V" = nên làm gì.

indirect_questions.q: Would you mind telling me ____ ?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: "where you live".

indirect_questions.q: Could you tell me (A) what time (B) does the (C) bank (D) close?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp không dùng "does": "what time the bank closes".
indirect_questions.r: Gián tiếp: S + V (không đảo, không trợ động từ)

indirect_questions.q: Can you (A) tell me (B) how far (C) the airport is and how long (D) does the trip take?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp không đảo, không dùng "does": "how long the trip takes" (giống vế trước "how far the airport is").

indirect_questions.q: Do you know where Tom ____?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: where + S + V, không dùng "does"; "Tom" số ít → lives.
indirect_questions.r: Do you know + Wh- + S + V?

indirect_questions.q: Excuse me, could you tell me ____ the ticket office is?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp giữ trật tự S + V: "where the ticket office is".

indirect_questions.q: I have no idea ____ he is so angry.
indirect_questions.e: why + S + V (không đảo ngữ).

indirect_questions.q: Can you tell me ____ the train to the airport leaves from this platform?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi Yes/No (có … không) → whether / if + S + V.

indirect_questions.q: I wonder how many people ____ to the meeting tomorrow.
indirect_questions.e: "how many people" là chủ ngữ → giữ trật tự: chủ ngữ + will + V.

indirect_questions.q: Do you know ____ this bag belongs to?
indirect_questions.e: "belong to + người" (thuộc về ai) → "who this bag belongs to".

indirect_questions.q: I'd like to know ____ you have worked here.
indirect_questions.e: how long + S + V (không đảo ngữ).

indirect_questions.q: The officer asked us ____ we were carrying any liquids.
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi Yes/No (có mang chất lỏng không) → whether / if.

indirect_questions.q: Do you know (A) where is (B) the post office? I (C) need to send (D) a letter.
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp không đảo ngữ: "where the post office is".
indirect_questions.r: Do you know + Wh- + S + V?
w: ✓ sai → where the post office is

indirect_questions.q: I (A) wonder (B) why is she (C) so quiet (D) today.
indirect_questions.e: Sau "I wonder" dùng trật tự câu kể: "why she is".

indirect_questions.q: Can you tell me (A) how (B) much (C) does this cost (D) in total?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp không dùng "does": "how much this costs".
indirect_questions.r: Gián tiếp: S + V (không trợ động từ)

indirect_questions.q: Please (A) let me (B) know (C) when (D) will you arrive.
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp giữ trật tự S + V: "when you will arrive".

indirect_questions.q: Where does Maria work?
o: Do you know where Maria works?
Do you know where does Maria work?
Do you know where Maria does work?
Do you know where works Maria?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp (lịch sự hơn): bỏ "does", trật tự S + V, động từ thêm -s.
indirect_questions.r: Do you know + Wh- + S + V?

indirect_questions.q: Is there a pharmacy near here?
o: Could you tell me if there is a pharmacy near here?
Could you tell me is there a pharmacy near here?
Could you tell me if is there a pharmacy near here?
Could you tell me that there is a pharmacy near here?
indirect_questions.e: Câu hỏi Yes/No → if + trật tự câu kể ("there is").
indirect_questions.r: Could you tell me if + S + V?

indirect_questions.q: What time did the film start?
o: Do you know what time the film started?
Do you know what time did the film start?
Do you know what time the film did start?
Do you know what time started the film?
