both_either_neither.e: Đồng ý khẳng định: "So + trợ động từ + S" (love → do).

both_either_neither.q: "I can't swim." — "____ can I."
both_either_neither.e: Đồng ý phủ định: "Neither + trợ động từ + S".

both_either_neither.q: ____ of my parents are teachers.
both_either_neither.e: "Both" + động từ số nhiều "are".

both_either_neither.q: I don't like coffee, and my wife doesn't ____.
both_either_neither.e: Phủ định → "either" cuối câu.

both_either_neither.q: "I've never been to Japan." — "Neither ____ I."
both_either_neither.e: Trợ động từ theo câu gốc (have been) → "Neither have I".

both_either_neither.q: "She was late again." — "So ____ he."
both_either_neither.e: "was" → "So was he".

both_either_neither.q: You can take ____ road — they both go to the city centre.
both_either_neither.e: "either + N số ít" = cái nào trong hai cũng được.

both_either_neither.q: ____ answer is correct — they're both wrong.
both_either_neither.e: "Neither + N số ít" = không cái nào trong hai.

both_either_neither.q: ____ my brother nor I went to the meeting.
both_either_neither.e: "Neither … nor".

both_either_neither.q: You can ____ stay here or come with us.
both_either_neither.e: "either … or".

both_either_neither.q: "I didn't enjoy the film." — "I didn't ____."
both_either_neither.e: Phủ định → "either".

both_either_neither.q: We invited two friends, but ____ of them came.
both_either_neither.e: Hai người, không ai đến → "neither of them".

both_either_neither.q: "I'd love to visit Iceland." — "So ____ I."
both_either_neither.e: "I'd love" = I would → "So would I".

both_either_neither.q: My sister doesn't eat meat, and ____ does her husband.
both_either_neither.e: "and neither does…" (đảo ngữ sau phủ định).

both_either_neither.q: She speaks ____ French and German fluently.
both_either_neither.e: "both … and".

both_either_neither.q: "I like jazz." — "(A) So (B) am (C) I," (D) said Tom.
both_either_neither.e: "like" → "do": "So do I".

both_either_neither.q: (A) Both (B) my brother (C) or (D) my sister can drive.
both_either_neither.e: "Both … and".

both_either_neither.q: "I haven't finished." — "(A) Neither (B) I (C) have," (D) she said.
both_either_neither.e: Đảo ngữ: "Neither have I".
w: ✓ sai trật tự: phải là "have I"

both_either_neither.q: Anna doesn't eat fish. Her husband doesn't eat fish either.
o: Neither Anna nor her husband eats fish.
Neither Anna or her husband eats fish.
Either Anna nor her husband eats fish.
Neither Anna nor her husband don't eat fish.
both_either_neither.e: "Neither … nor".

both_either_neither.q: Tom can play chess, and I can too.
o: Tom can play chess, and so can I.
Tom can play chess, and so I can.
Tom can play chess, and neither can I.
Tom can play chess, and so do I.
both_either_neither.e: "and so + aux + S".

both_either_neither.q: ____ my sisters are doctors.
both_either_neither.e: Cả hai + động từ số nhiều "are" → Both.
both_either_neither.r: both + danh từ số nhiều + V số nhiều

both_either_neither.q: "I can't stand loud music." "____ can I."
both_either_neither.e: Đồng ý với câu PHỦ ĐỊNH → Neither can I.
w: "So can I" cho câu khẳng định

both_either_neither.q: "I'm hungry." "So ____ I."
both_either_neither.e: Câu gốc dùng "am" → So am I.
both_either_neither.r: So + trợ động từ (theo câu gốc) + S

both_either_neither.q: You can have ____ tea or coffee.
both_either_neither.e: either … or = hoặc … hoặc.

both_either_neither.q: ____ of the two hotels had a room available, so we stayed with friends.
both_either_neither.e: Cả hai đều KHÔNG còn phòng → Neither of the two.
w: "both" = cả hai đều CÓ, mâu thuẫn

both_either_neither.q: "Tom didn't come to the meeting." "Sarah didn't ____."
both_either_neither.e: Đồng ý câu phủ định, đứng cuối → … didn't either.

both_either_neither.q: (A) Neither the manager (B) nor his assistants (C) was (D) at the meeting.
both_either_neither.e: "neither … nor": động từ theo chủ ngữ GẦN nhất (his assistants, số nhiều) → "were".
both_either_neither.r: neither A nor B + V theo B

both_either_neither.q: My husband (A) can't cook, and (B) neither (C) can't (D) I.
both_either_neither.e: "neither" đã mang nghĩa phủ định → "neither can I".
both_either_neither.r: neither + trợ động từ khẳng định

phrasal_verbs.q: Could you turn ____ the TV? I can't hear it.
phrasal_verbs.e: "turn up" = vặn to lên (không nghe được → vặn to).
phrasal_verbs.r: turn up = vặn to; turn down = vặn nhỏ

phrasal_verbs.q: Please fill ____ this form and return it to reception.
phrasal_verbs.r: fill in / fill out a form

phrasal_verbs.q: I'm looking ____ my glasses. Have you seen them?
She looks ____ her younger brother after school.
The meeting was called ____ because the manager was sick.
We ran ____ of milk, so I went to the shop.
I gave ____ smoking last year.
Can you pick me ____ at the airport tomorrow?
Please put ____ your shoes before you go out.
The plane took ____ an hour late.
phrasal_verbs.r: take off = cất cánh / cởi ra

phrasal_verbs.q: If you don't know the word, look it ____ in the dictionary.
We need to come ____ with a solution before Friday.
I get ____ well with my colleagues.
Don't (A) worry. You can (B) do it if you (C) don't give (D) off.
phrasal_verbs.e: Bỏ cuộc = "give up": "if you don't give up".

phrasal_verbs.q: My car (A) broke (B) up on the (C) way (D) to work this morning.
phrasal_verbs.e: Xe bị hỏng = "broke down"; "break up" = chia tay / tan rã.

phrasal_verbs.q: Please sit ____. The doctor will see you soon.
I wake ____ at six every morning.
Can you turn ____ the lights? It's too dark in here.
phrasal_verbs.e: Trời tối quá → bật đèn: turn on.
phrasal_verbs.r: turn on = bật; turn off / out = tắt

phrasal_verbs.q: My alarm clock didn't go ____ this morning, so I was late.
We need to find ____ why the system crashed.
She was brought ____ by her grandparents in a small village.
w: bring out = ra mắt sản phẩm

phrasal_verbs.q: The company had to lay ____ fifty workers last year.
phrasal_verbs.e: "lay off" = cho nghỉ việc (vì thiếu việc, khó khăn).

phrasal_verbs.q: I can't put ____ with this noise any longer.
We (A) ran away of (B) sugar, so I (C) went to (D) the store.
phrasal_verbs.e: Hết (đồ dùng) = "run out of": "ran out of sugar". "run away" = bỏ chạy.

phrasal_verbs.q: My sister's suitcase arrived late, so I (A) picked (B) up it (C) at the station (D) yesterday.
phrasal_verbs.e: Đại từ (it, them, him) phải đứng GIỮA động từ và tiểu từ: "picked it up".
phrasal_verbs.r: V + đại từ + tiểu từ (pick it up)

phrasal_verbs.q: The meeting (A) was (B) put (C) out until (D) next week.
phrasal_verbs.e: Hoãn lại = "put off": "was put off until next week".

phrasal_verbs.q: I (A) get (B) along (C) well (D) to my new roommate.
phrasal_verbs.e: Hoà hợp với ai = "get along with".
phrasal_verbs.r: get along / on with = hoà hợp

phrasal_verbs.q: The match was cancelled because of the snow.
o: The match was called off because of the snow.
The match was called up because of the snow.
The match was put on because of the snow.
The match was taken off because of the snow.

phrasal_verbs.q: I'm trying to find my keys.
She stopped eating sugar last year.
o: She gave up sugar last year.
She gave in sugar last year.
She gave away sugar last year.
She gave off sugar last year.

phrasal_verbs.q: We must think of a new idea quickly.
o: We must come up with a new idea quickly.
We must come across a new idea quickly.
We must come over a new idea quickly.
We must come down with a new idea quickly.
phrasal_verbs.e: "come up with" = nghĩ ra (ý tưởng, giải pháp).

phrasal_verbs.q: It's too quiet — could you ____ the music a bit?
I need to ____ early tomorrow for my flight.
Please ____ this form and hand it in.
Can you ____ my cat while I'm on holiday?
It took him months to ____ the flu.
We've ____ milk. Can you buy some?
The meeting has been ____ until next week.
I can't ____ his rudeness any longer.
She ____ her grandmother — they have the same eyes.
Let's ____ the details before we sign.
The car ____ on the motorway, so we called a mechanic.
I'll ____ you ____ at the station at six.
Prices of houses keep ____.
We need to ____ a solution before Friday.
I ____ an old photo while cleaning the attic.
The new rules will ____ next month.
The police are ____ the cause of the accident.
The fire alarm ____ in the middle of the night.
It's hard to ____ on a small salary.
Please (A) turn (B) off it (C) before (D) you leave.
phrasal_verbs.e: Phrasal verb tách được + đại từ → "turn it off".

phrasal_verbs.q: I've (A) run out (B) money, (C) so I can't (D) come.
Can you (A) look (B) after (C) this word (D) in the dictionary?
The match was postponed because of the rain.
o: The match was put off because of the rain.
The match was put up because of the rain.
The match was put on because of the rain.
The match was put away because of the rain.

phrasal_verbs.q: I can't tolerate this noise any more.
o: I can't put up with this noise any more.
I can't put off this noise any more.
I can't put up this noise any more.
I can't put on with this noise any more.

phrasal_verbs.q: Can you ____ the children while I'm at the doctor's?
phrasal_verbs.e: look after = trông nom, chăm sóc.

phrasal_verbs.q: The meeting was ____ because the director was ill.
w: "call up" = gọi điện / gọi nhập ngũ

word_forms.q: The ____ of the new product was very successful.
word_forms.e: Sau mạo từ "The" và trước "of" cần danh từ → "introduction".

word_forms.q: She is a very ____ worker.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ "worker" cần tính từ → "effective".

word_forms.q: He answered the question ____.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "answered" → trạng từ.
w: ✓ trạng từ bổ nghĩa động từ

word_forms.q: We need to ____ our marketing strategy.
word_forms.e: Sau "to" cần động từ → "strengthen" (làm mạnh hơn).

word_forms.q: The ____ were impressed by the presentation.
word_forms.e: Chủ ngữ số nhiều chỉ người ("những người tham dự") → "attendees".
w: danh từ chỉ sự tham dự

word_forms.q: The company has grown ____ over the last five years.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho "has grown" → trạng từ.
w: ✓ trạng từ bổ nghĩa động từ

word_forms.q: Thank you for your ____ in this matter.
word_forms.e: Sau tính từ sở hữu "your" cần danh từ.

word_forms.q: The instructions are not very ____.
word_forms.e: Sau "be + very" cần tính từ.

word_forms.q: She spoke ____ about her experience abroad.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho "spoke" → trạng từ.

word_forms.q: It is ____ to submit the form before the deadline.
word_forms.e: "It is + adj + to V".

word_forms.q: Our hotel offers ____ priced rooms for students.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ / phân từ "priced" → trạng từ.

word_forms.q: He has a lot of ____ in software development.
word_forms.e: Sau "a lot of" cần danh từ.

word_forms.q: The manager was ____ pleased with the results.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "pleased" → trạng từ.

word_forms.q: The (A) success of the project (B) depends on (C) careful (D) plan.
word_forms.e: Sau tính từ "careful" cần danh từ chỉ việc lập kế hoạch → "planning".

word_forms.q: She was (A) very (B) happily (C) with the (D) results.
word_forms.e: Sau "was very" cần tính từ "happy".

word_forms.q: She is a ____ singer.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ "singer" cần tính từ → beautiful.

word_forms.q: He drives very ____.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "drives" → trạng từ (đuôi -ly).
w: ✓ trạng từ bổ nghĩa động từ

word_forms.q: We were surprised by the ____ of the city.
word_forms.e: Sau "the" và trước "of" cần danh từ → beauty (vẻ đẹp).

word_forms.q: The new manager made several important ____.
word_forms.e: Sau "several" + tính từ "important" cần danh từ số nhiều → decisions.

word_forms.q: Please answer the questions ____.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "answer" → trạng từ.
w: ✓ trạng từ bổ nghĩa động từ

word_forms.q: Regular exercise can ____ your health.
word_forms.e: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu "can" cần động từ nguyên mẫu.

word_forms.q: The hotel staff were extremely ____ and answered all our questions.
word_forms.e: Sau "were extremely" cần tính từ → helpful.

word_forms.q: Prices have risen ____ since last year.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "have risen" → trạng từ.
w: ✓ trạng từ bổ nghĩa động từ

word_forms.q: The (A) beautifully garden (B) in front of (C) the house (D) belongs to my aunt.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ "garden" cần tính từ: "beautiful garden".

word_forms.q: His (A) speech was (B) inspire and (C) the audience (D) loved it.
word_forms.e: Sau "was" cần tính từ: "inspiring" (truyền cảm hứng).

word_forms.q: We (A) need (B) more (C) inform about (D) the new schedule.
word_forms.e: Sau "more" cần danh từ: "information" ("inform" là động từ).

word_forms.q: The children (A) played (B) happily in the park, but they (C) became (D) tiredly after an hour.
word_forms.e: "become" là động từ nối → theo sau là tính từ: "became tired".

word_forms.q: She sings beautifully.
word_forms.e: V + adv (sings beautifully) = adj + N (a beautiful singer).
w: trạng từ không đứng trước danh từ

word_forms.q: He answered the questions correctly.
o: His answers to the questions were correct.
His answers to the questions were correctly.
His answers to the questions were correction.
He answers to the questions were correct.
word_forms.e: Đổi động từ + trạng từ thành danh từ + be + tính từ.

word_forms.q: This dictionary is very useful.
o: This dictionary is of great use.
This dictionary is of great useful.
This dictionary is of great using.
word_forms.e: "of + danh từ" = tính từ: "of great use" = very useful.

word_forms.q: Our team worked very hard.
o: Our team was very hardly working.
word_forms.e: "work hard" = "hard-working" (chăm chỉ). Lưu ý: "hardly" = hầu như không.

word_forms.q: The ____ of the new stadium will cost millions.
word_forms.e: Sau "The" + trước "of" → danh từ.

word_forms.q: She answered the questions ____.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa động từ → trạng từ.

word_forms.q: It was a very ____ experience.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ → tính từ.

word_forms.q: The company plans to ____ its operations in Asia.
word_forms.e: Sau "to" → động từ.

word_forms.q: Doctors are looking for a ____ cure for the disease.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ → tính từ.

word_forms.q: His ____ to help surprised everyone.
word_forms.e: Sau tính từ sở hữu "His" → danh từ.
w: động từ chia, không đứng sau "His"

word_forms.q: The instructions were ____ clear.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa tính từ "clear" → trạng từ.

word_forms.q: She has a strong ____ for animals.
word_forms.e: Sau "a strong" → danh từ.

word_forms.q: The ____ of the city has doubled since 1990.
word_forms.e: Danh từ làm chủ ngữ.

word_forms.q: We were ____ by the beautiful scenery.
word_forms.e: "be + V3" (cảm thấy) → impressed.

word_forms.q: The test results were ____ — nobody passed.
word_forms.e: Kết quả GÂY thất vọng → -ing.

word_forms.q: Regular exercise can ____ your mood.
word_forms.e: Sau modal "can" → động từ nguyên mẫu.

word_forms.q: The proposal was rejected on the ____ that it was too expensive.
word_forms.e: "on the grounds that" = với lý do là.

word_forms.q: The new policy has had a ____ effect on small businesses.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ → tính từ "detrimental" (có hại).

word_forms.q: The museum offers free ____ on Sundays.
word_forms.e: Sau tính từ "free" → danh từ (vé vào cửa).

word_forms.q: He was ____ late, which annoyed his boss.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa tính từ "late" → trạng từ.

word_forms.q: The ____ of the two companies was announced today.
word_forms.e: Danh từ "merger" = sự sáp nhập.

word_forms.q: She is a very (A) success (B) businesswoman (C) in (D) her city.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ → tính từ "successful".

word_forms.q: The (A) decide (B) to close (C) the factory (D) was unpopular.
word_forms.e: Sau "The" → danh từ "decision".

word_forms.q: He drives (A) very (B) careless (C) and has had (D) several accidents.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa "drives" → trạng từ "carelessly".

word_forms.q: The (A) economical (B) situation (C) has improved (D) slightly.
word_forms.e: "economic" = thuộc kinh tế; "economical" = tiết kiệm.

word_forms.q: He apologised sincerely.
word_forms.e: adv + V → adj + N.

word_forms.q: It is impossible to predict the weather accurately.
o: Accurate prediction of the weather is impossible.
Accurately prediction of the weather is impossible.
Accurate predict of the weather is impossible.
Accuracy predicting of the weather is impossible.
word_forms.e: Danh từ hoá: adj + N.

word_forms.q: The ____ of the new software has been delayed until spring.
word_forms.e: Sau "The" và trước "of" cần danh từ → introduction.

word_forms.q: She answered the question very ____.
word_forms.e: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "answered" → trạng từ.

word_forms.q: The company is facing ____ competition from overseas.
word_forms.e: Trước danh từ "competition" cần tính từ → increasing (ngày càng tăng).

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The man ____ next to me on the plane was a famous writer.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động (who was sitting) → V-ing: "sitting".
w: thiếu "who", câu đã có ĐT chính "was"
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "was"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The products ____ in this factory are exported to Japan.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn bị động (which are made) → V3: "made".
w: V-ing là chủ động, sản phẩm không tự làm
✓ rút gọn bị động "which are made"
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "are exported"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ the email, she closed her laptop.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Gửi email xong TRƯỚC rồi mới đóng máy, cùng chủ ngữ "she" → "Having sent".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: Having + V3 = đã làm xong trước
w: ✓ gửi xong trước rồi mới đóng máy
V3 đầu câu mang nghĩa bị động
"send" phải là "sent", và nghĩa bị động

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ by the noise, the baby started to cry.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Em bé bị đánh thức (bị động) → phân từ V3 "Woken".
w: V-ing chủ động, nhưng em bé bị đánh thức
✓ V3 bị động, có "by the noise"
V nguyên mẫu không làm phân từ

reduced_clauses_participles.q: He was the first person ____ the finish line.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Sau "the first / the last / the only" rút gọn bằng "to V".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: the first / last / only + to V

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ in 1990, the company now has over 500 employees.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Công ty được thành lập (bị động) → "Founded".
w: chủ động, công ty không tự thành lập
✓ bị động: công ty được thành lập
chủ động hoàn thành, sai nghĩa
"to V" chỉ mục đích, sai nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Anyone ____ to join the club should contact Ms. Lan.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn "who wishes" → "wishing".
w: thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "should contact"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ tired, I went to bed early.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Cảm thấy mệt (chủ động, cùng chủ ngữ "I") → "Feeling".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: V-ing đầu câu: chủ động, cùng chủ ngữ
w: "feel" không dùng bị động ở đây
"to V" chỉ mục đích, sai nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The book ____ on the table belongs to my sister.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn "which is lying" → "lying" (nội động từ "lie" = nằm). Câu đã có động từ chính "belongs" nên không dùng thêm "lies / lays"; "lain" là V3, không mang nghĩa chủ động.
w: V3 của "lie", không mang nghĩa đang nằm
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "belongs"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Not ____ what to say, he remained silent.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Phân từ phủ định: Not + V-ing (vì không biết…).
w: ĐT chia không đứng sau "Not" đầu câu
"Not to know" không chỉ lý do

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ his homework, Tom went out to play.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Làm xong bài TRƯỚC rồi mới đi chơi, Tom tự làm (chủ động) → phân từ hoàn thành "Having finished". "Finished / Being finished" mang nghĩa bị động; "To finish" chỉ mục đích, không hợp nghĩa.
reduced_clauses_participles.r: Having + V3 = đã làm xong trước
w: bị động, nhưng Tom tự làm
✓ làm xong trước rồi mới đi chơi
"to V" chỉ mục đích, sai nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Most of the people ____ to the party didn't come.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Những người được mời (bị động) → "invited".
w: chủ động: người đi mời, sai nghĩa
✓ rút gọn bị động "who were invited"
"who invited" = người đã mời, sai nghĩa
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "didn't come"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: (A) Walked along the beach, we (B) saw (C) a group of (D) dolphins.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: "Chúng tôi đi bộ" là chủ động → "Walking along the beach".
w: đúng: quá khứ đơn kể chuyện
đúng: "a group of" + N số nhiều

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The (A) report (B) written by (C) the team (D) were excellent.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Chủ ngữ chính "The report" số ít → "was excellent".
w: đúng: chủ ngữ chính số ít
đúng: rút gọn "which was written by"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Passengers ____ for the morning flight should go to Gate 12.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Hành khách TỰ chờ (chủ động) → rút gọn "who are waiting" thành "waiting". Câu đã có động từ chính "should go".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: N + V-ing = who + be + V-ing (chủ động)
w: thiếu "who", câu đã có ĐT chính
V3 mang nghĩa bị động, sai
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "should go"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Most of the furniture ____ in the hotel lobby is handmade.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Đồ đạc ĐƯỢC trưng bày (bị động) → rút gọn "which is displayed" thành "displayed".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: N + V3 = which + be + V3 (bị động)
w: chủ động, đồ đạc không tự trưng bày
✓ rút gọn bị động "which is displayed"
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "is handmade"
thừa ĐT chia thứ hai trong câu

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ from the top of the tower, the city looks like a toy model.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Chủ ngữ của câu là "the city". Thành phố ĐƯỢC nhìn từ trên tháp (bị động) → "Seen".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: V3 đầu câu = bị động, cùng chủ ngữ với vế sau
w: chủ động: thành phố không tự nhìn
✓ bị động: thành phố được nhìn
chủ động hoàn thành, sai chủ ngữ
"to V" chỉ mục đích, sai nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: She was the only candidate ____ all three languages fluently.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Sau "the only / the first / the last + N" rút gọn mệnh đề bằng "to V": "the only candidate to speak" = ứng viên duy nhất nói được.
reduced_clauses_participles.r: the only / first / last + N + to V
w: thiếu "who", câu đã có ĐT chính
V3 mang nghĩa bị động, sai
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "was"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ in Paris for ten years, she knows the city very well.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Cô ấy đã sống ở đó 10 năm (việc xảy ra trước, tự làm) → phân từ hoàn thành "Having lived".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: Having + V3 = đã làm trước (chủ động)
w: V3 đầu câu mang nghĩa bị động
✓ đã sống 10 năm, việc xảy ra trước
"to V" chỉ mục đích, sai nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The bridge, ____ over a century ago, is still in use today.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Cây cầu ĐƯỢC xây (bị động). Mệnh đề bổ sung "which was built…" rút gọn thành "built".
w: chủ động: cầu không tự xây
✓ rút gọn bị động "which was built"
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "is"

reduced_clauses_participles.q: There are still a few tickets ____ for tonight's show.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: "There are + N + left" = còn lại (rút gọn "which are left").
reduced_clauses_participles.r: There is / are + N + left = còn lại
w: ✓ rút gọn "which are left" = còn lại
thừa ĐT chia, câu đã có "are"
"to leave" = để rời đi, sai nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The (A) letters (B) sending last week (C) have not (D) arrived yet.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Thư ĐƯỢC gửi (bị động) → phải là "sent last week" (= which were sent last week).
w: đúng: hợp chủ ngữ số nhiều

reduced_clauses_participles.q: (A) Having lost (B) his job, (C) the bank refused (D) to give him a loan.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Phân từ đầu câu phải cùng chủ ngữ với vế sau. Người mất việc là "he", không phải ngân hàng → sửa: "he was refused a loan by the bank".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: Phân từ đầu câu = cùng chủ ngữ với vế sau
w: ✓ sai: ngân hàng không mất việc, sai chủ ngữ

reduced_clauses_participles.q: (A) Interesting in history, she (B) spends (C) most weekends (D) visiting museums.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Cô ấy CẢM THẤY thích lịch sử → "Interested in history". "interesting" nghĩa là "gây hứng thú" cho người khác.
reduced_clauses_participles.r: interested (người cảm thấy) / interesting (gây ra cảm giác)
w: đúng: hiện tại đơn, thói quen

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The (A) woman (B) standing near the door (C) is my aunt, (D) who living in Rome.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Nếu đã có "who" thì phải có động từ chia: "who lives in Rome".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: who + ĐT chia; bỏ "who" mới rút gọn thành V-ing
w: ✓ sai: "who" cần ĐT chia: who lives

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The woman who is talking to the manager is my sister.
o: The woman talking to the manager is my sister.
The woman talked to the manager is my sister.
The woman was talking to the manager and my sister.
The manager talking to the woman is my sister.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động "who is talking" rút gọn thành "talking". Các câu khác sai dạng hoặc đổi nghĩa.
w: V3 mang nghĩa bị động, sai
đổi nghĩa, thành 2 người khác nhau
đảo vai: người quản lý là chị tôi

reduced_clauses_participles.q: After she had finished her speech, she answered questions from the audience.
o: Finished her speech, she answered questions from the audience.
Having finished her speech, she answered questions from the audience.
Finishing her speech, the audience asked her questions.
Having been finished her speech, she answered questions from the audience.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: "After she had finished…" (xong trước) = "Having finished…", cùng chủ ngữ "she".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: After + S + had V3 = Having + V3
w: V3 đầu câu mang nghĩa bị động
✓ phân từ hoàn thành, cùng chủ ngữ
sai chủ ngữ: khán giả không phát biểu

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Because he didn't feel well, Tom stayed at home.
o: Not felt well, Tom stayed at home.
Not feeling well, Tom stayed at home.
Feeling not well, Tom stayed at home.
Not to feel well, Tom stayed at home.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Lý do ở dạng phủ định rút gọn thành "Not + V-ing": "Not feeling well" = vì không khoẻ.
w: V3 mang nghĩa bị động, sai
"to V" chỉ mục đích, sai nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The museum, which was designed by a young architect, opened last spring.
o: The museum, designing by a young architect, opened last spring.
The museum, having designed by a young architect, opened last spring.
The museum, designed by a young architect, opened last spring.
The young architect, designed the museum, opened last spring.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Bảo tàng ĐƯỢC thiết kế → rút gọn bị động "which was designed" thành "designed".
w: V-ing chủ động, bảo tàng không tự thiết kế
✓ rút gọn bị động "which was designed"
sai cấu trúc và đổi nghĩa

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The woman ____ at the reception desk will give you a key.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: who is sitting → sitting.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The books ____ in this shop are all second-hand.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Bị động: which are sold → sold.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ the door, she found a letter on the floor.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Hai hành động cùng chủ ngữ, nối tiếp → phân từ hiện tại.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ in 1990, the building needs major repairs.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Bị động (toà nhà được xây) → V3.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ all my work, I went to bed.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Việc xong trước việc sau → "Having V3".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Anyone ____ to join the club should contact Sarah.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn: who wants → wanting.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The first person ____ the summit was a Sherpa.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Sau "the first / last / only" → "to V".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ by the news, she sat down in silence.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Bị động (cô ấy bị sốc) → V3.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Not ____ what to say, he left the room.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Phủ định phân từ: "Not + V-ing".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ his age, he is remarkably fit.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: "Considering + N" = xét đến (giới từ hoá).

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The weather ____ fine, we decided to go for a picnic.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Phân từ tuyệt đối: chủ ngữ riêng + V-ing.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: All things ____, it was a successful year.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Thành ngữ "All things considered" = xét mọi mặt.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ from a distance, the rock looks like a face.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Hòn đá "được nhìn" → V3.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The students (A) taken (B) part (C) in the competition (D) received certificates.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Chủ động "who took part" → "taking part".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: (A) Walking (B) down the street, (C) the rain (D) started.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Phân từ treo: "the rain" không thể "walking" → "I was caught in the rain" / "it started to rain".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: Chủ ngữ phải là người thực hiện phân từ

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The letter (A) writing (B) by my grandfather (C) is (D) very old.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Bị động → "written".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: (A) Having (B) finish (C) the meal, (D) we paid the bill.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: "Having + V3" → "finished".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The girl who is wearing a red dress is my sister.
o: The girl wearing a red dress is my sister.
The girl worn a red dress is my sister.
The girl wears a red dress is my sister.
The girl is wearing a red dress is my sister.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn chủ động → V-ing.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: After she had read the letter, she burst into tears.
o: Having read the letter, she burst into tears.
Having reading the letter, she burst into tears.
Had read the letter, she burst into tears.
Read the letter, she burst into tears.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn trước – sau → "Having V3".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Because he didn't have a key, he had to wait outside.
o: Not having a key, he had to wait outside.
Having not a key, he had to wait outside.
Not had a key, he had to wait outside.
No having a key, he had to wait outside.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Phủ định: "Not + V-ing".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The woman ____ next to me on the train was reading a fascinating book.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động (who was sitting) → V-ing.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Most of the products ____ in this factory are exported to Asia.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn bị động (that are made) → V3.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ the email, she realised she had made a mistake.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Hai việc cùng chủ ngữ, chủ động → mệnh đề phân từ V-ing.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ in 1890, the bridge is the oldest in the city.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Cây cầu ĐƯỢC xây → phân từ V3 (bị động).
w: chủ động, sai (cầu không tự xây)

reduced_clauses_participles.q: ____ all her work, she went home early.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Việc xong TRƯỚC (rồi mới về) → Having + V3.

reduced_clauses_participles.q: Passengers ____ for Flight 207 should go to Gate 12 immediately.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động (who are waiting) → V-ing.
w: động từ chia, câu có 2 động từ chính

reduced_clauses_participles.q: The documents (A) sending (B) yesterday (C) have not (D) arrived yet.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Tài liệu ĐƯỢC gửi → rút gọn bị động: "sent".

reduced_clauses_participles.q: (A) Walking along the beach, (B) the sunset (C) was (D) beautiful.
reduced_clauses_participles.e: Chủ ngữ của "Walking" phải là người đi dạo, không phải "the sunset" → "we watched a beautiful sunset".
reduced_clauses_participles.r: Chủ ngữ mệnh đề chính = chủ ngữ của phân từ
w: ✓ sai: chủ ngữ phải là người đi dạo

adverbial_clauses.q: Make sure you lock the door before you ____ the house tonight.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mệnh đề thời gian (before, after, when, as soon as…) nói về tương lai → dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng "will".
adverbial_clauses.r: before / after + hiện tại đơn (nghĩa tương lai)
w: ✓ hiện tại đơn mang nghĩa tương lai

adverbial_clauses.q: She saved money ____ she could buy a new laptop.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mục đích → "so that + S + can/could + V".
w: chỉ sự trái ngược, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ he was ill, he couldn't go to work.
adverbial_clauses.e: "Since" = vì (lý do).
w: chỉ sự trái ngược, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: We left early ____ miss the traffic.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mục đích phủ định + V → "so as not to / in order not to + V".
w: "so that" cần mệnh đề có chủ ngữ

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ I finish this report, I'll join you for lunch.
adverbial_clauses.e: "Once" = một khi (ngay khi).
w: chỉ sự trái ngược, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: He spoke slowly ____ everyone could understand him.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mục đích + mệnh đề (everyone could understand) → "so that". "in order to / so as to" chỉ đi với V nguyên mẫu; "because of" + N.
w: "in order to" + V, không + mệnh đề

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ the time we arrived, the concert had already started.
adverbial_clauses.e: "By the time" + quá khứ, quá khứ hoàn thành.
adverbial_clauses.r: By the time + S + V2, S + had V3

adverbial_clauses.q: She studied hard ____ pass the entrance exam.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mục đích + V nguyên mẫu → "in order to".
w: "so that" cần mệnh đề có chủ ngữ
"so" chỉ kết quả, cần mệnh đề

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ you finish your homework, you can't watch TV.
adverbial_clauses.e: "Until" = cho đến khi (chưa làm xong thì chưa được).
w: sai nghĩa: làm xong lại không được xem
✓ chưa xong thì chưa được xem
sai nghĩa: xong rồi lại không được
sai nghĩa: xong rồi lại không được

adverbial_clauses.q: It was raining hard, ____ the match was cancelled.
adverbial_clauses.e: Kết quả → "so".
w: đảo quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả
chỉ sự trái ngược, sai nghĩa
chỉ sự đối lập, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ she was walking home, she saw an accident.
adverbial_clauses.e: "While + S + V" = trong khi.
w: cần N / V-ing, và sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: Now ____ you have finished school, what will you do?
adverbial_clauses.e: "Now that" = vì giờ đây (lý do).
w: "now when" không phải cụm cố định

adverbial_clauses.q: I (A) will (B) wait here (C) until you (D) will come back.
adverbial_clauses.e: Sau "until" (mệnh đề thời gian tương lai) dùng hiện tại đơn "come".
w: đúng: tương lai ở mệnh đề chính
đúng: ĐT + trạng từ nơi chốn

adverbial_clauses.q: He works (A) two jobs (B) so that (C) to support (D) his family.
adverbial_clauses.e: "so that" cần mệnh đề; với "to V" phải dùng "in order to / so as to".
adverbial_clauses.r: in order to + V; so that + S + V
w: đúng: to V chỉ mục đích

adverbial_clauses.q: Please call me as soon as you ____ at the airport.
adverbial_clauses.e: "as soon as" (ngay khi) nói về tương lai → dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng "will".
adverbial_clauses.r: as soon as + hiện tại đơn (nghĩa tương lai)
w: ✓ hiện tại đơn mang nghĩa tương lai
quá khứ, không hợp lời nhờ

adverbial_clauses.q: The bag was ____ heavy that I couldn't lift it.
adverbial_clauses.e: "so + tính từ + that" = quá … đến nỗi. "such" phải đi với danh từ: "such a heavy bag".

adverbial_clauses.q: The roads were icy; ____, many schools closed for the day.
adverbial_clauses.e: "as a result" = kết quả là. Đứng sau dấu chấm phẩy, có dấu phẩy theo sau.
adverbial_clauses.r: ; as a result, + mệnh đề kết quả
w: ✓ as a result = kết quả là
chỉ sự trái ngược, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: She wrote the address down ____ she forgot it.
adverbial_clauses.e: "in case" = phòng khi. Cô ấy ghi lại địa chỉ phòng khi quên.
adverbial_clauses.r: in case + S + V = phòng khi
w: mục đích: thành "để quên", sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ the shop was closed, we went to the café next door.
adverbial_clauses.e: "As" = vì (chỉ lý do), giống "since / because". Cửa hàng đóng nên chúng tôi sang quán cà phê.
adverbial_clauses.r: as / since / because + S + V = vì
w: chỉ sự trái ngược, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ she saw the spider, she screamed.
adverbial_clauses.e: "The moment (that)" = ngay khi. Vừa thấy con nhện là hét lên.
adverbial_clauses.r: the moment + S + V = ngay khi
w: cần quá khứ hoàn thành ở vế sau

adverbial_clauses.q: There was ____ traffic that we missed the start of the film.
adverbial_clauses.e: "traffic" là danh từ không đếm được → "so much + N không đếm được + that".
adverbial_clauses.r: so much + N không đếm được + that
w: "so" không đi thẳng với danh từ
✓ so much + N không đếm được

adverbial_clauses.q: We took a taxi (A) so that (B) we (C) would not to be (D) late.
adverbial_clauses.e: Sau "would (not)" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không "to": "would not be late".
adverbial_clauses.r: so that + S + would / could + V

adverbial_clauses.q: (A) Because of the road was icy, (B) the bus (C) moved (D) very slowly.
o: Because of the road was icy
adverbial_clauses.e: "because of" + danh từ. Trước mệnh đề (the road was icy) phải dùng "because".
adverbial_clauses.r: because + S + V; because of + N

adverbial_clauses.q: He left (A) the party early (B) so as (C) he could catch (D) the last bus.
adverbial_clauses.e: Trước một mệnh đề (he could catch…) phải dùng "so that". "so as" chỉ đi với "to V": "so as to catch".
adverbial_clauses.r: so that + S + V; so as to + V
w: ✓ sai: trước mệnh đề dùng "so that"
đúng: could + V chỉ mục đích

adverbial_clauses.q: She (A) left (B) early (C) so that she (D) can catch the six o'clock train.
adverbial_clauses.e: Câu kể chuyện quá khứ (left) → sau "so that" dùng "could": "so that she could catch the train".
adverbial_clauses.r: quá khứ + so that + S + could / would + V
w: ✓ sai: chuyện quá khứ → could catch

adverbial_clauses.q: We left early because we wanted to avoid the traffic.
o: We left early so as to avoid the traffic.
We left early so that avoiding the traffic.
We left early because of avoid the traffic.
We avoided the traffic, so we left early.
adverbial_clauses.e: "because we wanted to avoid" nói mục đích → "so as to avoid" (để tránh).
adverbial_clauses.r: so as to / in order to + V = để
w: ✓ so as to + V chỉ mục đích
"so that" cần mệnh đề có chủ ngữ
đảo nguyên nhân và kết quả

adverbial_clauses.q: Since everyone was tired, we ended the meeting early.
o: We ended the meeting early because everyone was tired.
We ended the meeting early so that everyone was tired.
We ended the meeting early although everyone was tired.
Everyone was tired because we ended the meeting early.
adverbial_clauses.e: "Since" = "because" (vì). Mệt là lý do, kết thúc sớm là kết quả.
w: đảo nguyên nhân và kết quả

adverbial_clauses.q: As soon as she got home, she turned on the heating.
o: The moment she got home, she turned on the heating.
Until she got home, she turned on the heating.
She turned on the heating before she got home.
By the time she turned on the heating, she got home.
adverbial_clauses.e: "As soon as" = "The moment" (ngay khi): về đến nhà là bật máy sưởi.
adverbial_clauses.r: as soon as = the moment = ngay khi
w: bật trước khi về, sai thứ tự
sai thứ tự và sai thì

adverbial_clauses.q: I'll take an umbrella because it might rain.
o: I'll take an umbrella so that it might rain.
I'll take an umbrella in case it rains.
I'll take an umbrella unless it rains.
I'll take an umbrella until it rains.
adverbial_clauses.e: "because it might rain" = phòng khi trời mưa → "in case it rains" (sau "in case" dùng hiện tại đơn).
adverbial_clauses.r: in case + hiện tại đơn = phòng khi

adverbial_clauses.q: I'll text you ____ I get to the airport.
adverbial_clauses.e: "as soon as" = ngay khi.
adverbial_clauses.r: as soon as + hiện tại đơn (tương lai)

adverbial_clauses.q: She saved money every month ____ she could buy a car.
adverbial_clauses.e: "so that + S + could / can" = để mà (mục đích).

adverbial_clauses.q: We stayed indoors ____ the storm was over.
adverbial_clauses.e: "until" = cho tới khi.

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ the shops close early on Sundays, we did our shopping on Saturday.
adverbial_clauses.e: "As" = vì (lý do đã biết).

adverbial_clauses.q: He spoke quietly ____ wake the baby.
adverbial_clauses.e: "so as not to + V" = để không.
adverbial_clauses.r: so as not to / in order not to + V

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ had I sat down than the phone rang.
adverbial_clauses.e: "No sooner … than".
adverbial_clauses.r: No sooner + had S V3 + than

adverbial_clauses.q: The film was ____ boring that we left halfway through.
adverbial_clauses.e: "so + adj + that".

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ you've finished your coffee, we can go.
adverbial_clauses.e: "Now that" = vì giờ đã…

adverbial_clauses.q: I'll wait here ____ you get back.
adverbial_clauses.e: "until" = cho tới khi.
w: "by the time" = trước lúc, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ I was walking home, it started to pour.
adverbial_clauses.e: "While + mệnh đề".

adverbial_clauses.q: Take notes ____ you forget anything important.
adverbial_clauses.e: "in case" = phòng khi.
w: "so that you forget" = để quên, sai nghĩa

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ the time the firefighters got there, the house had burnt down.
adverbial_clauses.e: "By the time + V2" = vào lúc / trước lúc (việc kia đã xong).

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ was his anger that he couldn't speak.
adverbial_clauses.e: Đảo ngữ "Such + be + N + that".

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ tired was she that she fell asleep at her desk.
adverbial_clauses.e: Đảo ngữ "So + adj + be + S + that".

adverbial_clauses.q: The meeting was postponed ____ the manager was ill.
adverbial_clauses.e: "because + mệnh đề"; "owing to / due to" + danh từ.

adverbial_clauses.q: I will call you (A) when (B) I (C) will arrive (D) home.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mệnh đề thời gian → hiện tại đơn: "arrive".

adverbial_clauses.q: She left early (A) so that (B) she (C) could (D) catching the last train.
adverbial_clauses.e: Sau "could" là V nguyên mẫu: "catch".

adverbial_clauses.q: (A) Because of (B) it was raining, (C) we (D) stayed home.
adverbial_clauses.e: "Because + mệnh đề".

adverbial_clauses.q: It was (A) so (B) a difficult exam (C) that (D) few people passed.
adverbial_clauses.e: "such a + adj + N" → "such".

adverbial_clauses.q: He trained hard because he wanted to win the race.
o: He trained hard in order to win the race.
He trained hard in order winning the race.
He trained hard so that win the race.
He trained hard for win the race.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mục đích → "in order to + V".

adverbial_clauses.q: The coffee was very hot. I couldn't drink it.
o: The coffee was so hot that I couldn't drink it.
The coffee was such hot that I couldn't drink it.
The coffee was too hot that I couldn't drink it.
The coffee was so hot for me to drink it.
adverbial_clauses.e: "so + adj + that".

adverbial_clauses.q: The noise was so loud that we couldn't sleep.
o: Such was the noise that we couldn't sleep.
So was the noise that we couldn't sleep.
Such the noise was that we couldn't sleep.
So loud the noise was that we couldn't sleep.
adverbial_clauses.e: Đảo ngữ "Such + be + N + that".

adverbial_clauses.q: Please stay in your seats ____ the plane has come to a complete stop.
adverbial_clauses.e: Ngồi yên cho đến khi máy bay dừng hẳn → until.

adverbial_clauses.q: She saved money ____ she could buy a car.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mục đích + "could" → so that.

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ I arrived at the station, the train had left.
adverbial_clauses.e: Tới lúc tôi đến thì tàu đã đi → By the time + quá khứ đơn, had V3.
adverbial_clauses.r: By the time + V2, had V3

adverbial_clauses.q: ____ he was ill, he stayed at home.
adverbial_clauses.e: As = vì (nêu lý do).

adverbial_clauses.q: Turn off the lights ____ you leave the room.
adverbial_clauses.e: Khi rời phòng thì tắt đèn → when.

adverbial_clauses.q: I'll call you (A) as soon as (B) I (C) will get (D) home.
adverbial_clauses.e: Mệnh đề thời gian dùng hiện tại đơn → "get".
adverbial_clauses.r: as soon as + hiện tại đơn

concession_contrast.q: ____ the heavy rain, the match continued.
concession_contrast.e: Theo sau là cụm danh từ → "In spite of".
w: "although" + mệnh đề, không + cụm danh từ
✓ in spite of + cụm danh từ

concession_contrast.q: ____ he worked hard, he didn't get a promotion.
concession_contrast.e: Mệnh đề (S + V) → "Even though".
w: "in spite of" + N / V-ing, không + mệnh đề
"however" không nối 2 mệnh đề như vậy

concession_contrast.q: The plan was risky. ____, the board approved it.
concession_contrast.e: Liên từ nối 2 câu, đứng đầu câu có dấu phẩy → "Nevertheless".
w: ✓ trạng từ nối câu, có dấu phẩy

concession_contrast.q: ____ being tired, she finished the marathon.
concession_contrast.e: "Despite + V-ing".

concession_contrast.q: ____ hard he tries, he can't solve the puzzle.
concession_contrast.e: "However + adj/adv + S + V" = dù … đến đâu.
w: sai trật tự: "although" không đi với "hard" như vậy

concession_contrast.q: Despite ____ a lot, he failed the test.
concession_contrast.e: Sau "Despite" dùng V-ing / N.

concession_contrast.q: ____ the fact that it was late, we kept working.
concession_contrast.e: "Despite the fact that + S + V".
concession_contrast.r: despite the fact that + S + V
w: ✓ despite the fact that + S + V

concession_contrast.q: ____ expensive the hotel is, it's always full.
concession_contrast.e: "No matter how + adj + S + V" = dù … thế nào.
w: "although" không đứng trước tính từ như vậy
✓ no matter how + adj + S + V

concession_contrast.q: Much ____ I admire his work, I can't agree with him.
concession_contrast.e: Cấu trúc nhượng bộ "Much as + S + V" = dù rất …
w: ✓ Much as + S + V = dù rất

concession_contrast.q: She is friendly; ____, she can be quite strict.
concession_contrast.e: Nối 2 mệnh đề độc lập bằng dấu chấm phẩy → "however".
w: "although" không đứng sau ";" kèm dấu phẩy
✓ dấu chấm phẩy + "however," nối 2 mệnh đề
"even though" không đi với dấu phẩy sau

concession_contrast.q: Tired ____ she was, she continued working.
concession_contrast.e: Đảo ngữ nhượng bộ: Adj + as/though + S + be.
w: không dùng "although" trong đảo ngữ này

concession_contrast.q: In spite ____ the delay, we arrived on time.
concession_contrast.e: "In spite of".

concession_contrast.q: (A) Although (B) the bad weather, (C) we enjoyed (D) the trip.
concession_contrast.e: Theo sau là cụm danh từ → dùng "Despite / In spite of".
w: ✓ sai: trước cụm danh từ dùng "Despite"

concession_contrast.q: She (A) arrived (B) on time (C) despite of (D) the heavy traffic.
concession_contrast.e: "despite" không đi với "of": dùng "despite the heavy traffic" hoặc "in spite of the heavy traffic".
concession_contrast.r: despite / in spite of (không có "despite of")

concession_contrast.q: The flight was delayed for hours. The passengers, ____, stayed calm.
concession_contrast.e: "however" là trạng từ nối, có thể đứng giữa câu, giữa hai dấu phẩy. "although / even though" cần mệnh đề theo sau, "despite" cần danh từ.
w: ✓ trạng từ nối, đứng giữa hai dấu phẩy
cần danh từ / V-ing theo sau

concession_contrast.q: ____ having little experience, he got the job.
concession_contrast.e: Theo sau là V-ing (having) → dùng "In spite of / Despite".
w: không đi với V-ing như vậy

concession_contrast.q: Some people love the city, ____ others find it too noisy.
concession_contrast.e: "while" = trong khi, dùng để đối lập hai ý trong cùng một câu.
w: trạng từ, cần dấu chấm phẩy trước

concession_contrast.q: ____ you may think, learning a language after 40 is not impossible.
concession_contrast.e: "Whatever you may think" = dù bạn nghĩ gì đi nữa. "think" cần tân ngữ, "whatever" làm tân ngữ đó.

concession_contrast.q: The test was difficult. ____, most students passed.
concession_contrast.e: "Even so" = dù vậy, đứng đầu câu có dấu phẩy.
w: + N / V-ing, không đứng một mình

concession_contrast.q: Strange ____ it may seem, I actually enjoy doing housework.
concession_contrast.e: Đảo ngữ nhượng bộ: tính từ + as + S + V = dù … đến đâu. "Strange as it may seem" = dù nghe có vẻ lạ.
w: không dùng "although" trong đảo ngữ này

concession_contrast.q: She kept smiling ____ she was very nervous.
concession_contrast.e: Theo sau là mệnh đề (she was very nervous) → "even though".
w: không nối 2 mệnh đề như vậy

concession_contrast.q: She (A) went to work (B) as usual (C) in spite of (D) she had a fever.
concession_contrast.e: Theo sau là mệnh đề (she had a fever) → dùng "although / even though". Hoặc đổi thành "in spite of having a fever".
concession_contrast.r: although + S + V; in spite of + N / V-ing

concession_contrast.q: (A) Even the rain was heavy, (B) we decided (C) to go (D) for a walk.
concession_contrast.e: "Even" không phải liên từ, không nối mệnh đề được → "Even though the rain was heavy".
w: ✓ sai: phải là "Even though" + mệnh đề

concession_contrast.q: He (A) is very rich; (B) although, he (C) lives (D) in a small flat.
concession_contrast.e: Sau dấu chấm phẩy, nối hai mệnh đề bằng trạng từ "however," (có dấu phẩy). "although" không đi với dấu phẩy như vậy.

concession_contrast.q: He didn't (A) give up (B) even though (C) he had (D) failing many times.
concession_contrast.e: Sau "had" dùng V3: "he had failed many times".
concession_contrast.r: even though + S + V chia đúng thì

concession_contrast.q: Although she was ill, she went to the meeting.
o: Despite being ill, she went to the meeting.
Despite she was ill, she went to the meeting.
Because she was ill, she went to the meeting.
In spite of ill, she went to the meeting.
concession_contrast.e: "Although + mệnh đề" = "Despite + V-ing": "Despite being ill" = dù bị ốm.
concession_contrast.r: although + S + V = despite + V-ing / N

concession_contrast.q: He is very young, but he is the team captain.
o: Young as he is, he is the team captain.
As young he is, he is the team captain.
He is so young that he is the team captain.
Because he is young, he is the team captain.
concession_contrast.e: "Young as he is" = dù còn trẻ (đảo ngữ nhượng bộ: tính từ đứng trước "as").
concession_contrast.r: Adj + as + S + V = Although + S + V + adj
w: sai trật tự: tính từ đứng trước "as"
thành quan hệ kết quả, sai nghĩa
thành quan hệ lý do, sai nghĩa

concession_contrast.q: It doesn't matter how hard you push; the door won't open.
o: However hard you push, the door won't open.
However you push hard, the door won't open.
Although hard you push, the door won't open.
Despite pushing hard, the door won't open.
concession_contrast.e: "However + tính từ / trạng từ + S + V" = dù … đến đâu. "hard" phải đứng ngay sau "However".
w: "although" không đi với cấu trúc này
sai chủ ngữ: cửa không tự đẩy

concession_contrast.q: The plan was expensive. Nevertheless, the council approved it.
o: The council approved the plan because it was expensive.
The council approved the plan in spite of its high cost.
The council didn't approve the plan as it was expensive.
Despite the council approved it, the plan was expensive.
concession_contrast.e: "Nevertheless" = tuy vậy → "in spite of + cụm danh từ" (its high cost = chi phí cao của nó).
concession_contrast.r: Nevertheless ≈ in spite of / despite + N
w: ✓ in spite of + cụm danh từ

concession_contrast.q: ____ it was late, the café was still full.
concession_contrast.e: "Although + mệnh đề".
w: "However" đứng đầu câu cần dấu phẩy và câu riêng

concession_contrast.q: ____ the traffic, we arrived on time.
concession_contrast.e: "Despite + N".

concession_contrast.q: The hotel was expensive. ____, the service was poor.
concession_contrast.e: "However," nối 2 câu riêng.
w: cần mệnh đề phụ trong cùng câu

concession_contrast.q: In spite ____ tired, she kept working.
concession_contrast.e: "In spite of + V-ing".

concession_contrast.q: ____ hard he tried, he couldn't open the jar.
concession_contrast.e: "However + adj / adv + S + V" = dù… đến đâu.

concession_contrast.q: ____ I admire his talent, I don't like his attitude.
concession_contrast.e: "While" = mặc dù / trong khi (nhượng bộ).

concession_contrast.q: She went to work ____ she had a high fever.
concession_contrast.e: "even though + clause" (nhấn mạnh hơn although).

concession_contrast.q: The job is well paid. It is, ____, very stressful.
concession_contrast.e: "however" đứng giữa câu, giữa 2 dấu phẩy.

concession_contrast.q: He's very rich. ____, he lives in a tiny flat.
concession_contrast.e: "Nevertheless" = tuy nhiên (trang trọng).

concession_contrast.q: ____ as it may seem, the story is true.
concession_contrast.e: Đảo nhượng bộ: "Adj + as + S + may seem" = dù có vẻ…
w: "However strange it may seem" mới đúng, "However strange as" sai

concession_contrast.q: ____ as I would like to help, I simply don't have the time.
concession_contrast.e: "Much as + clause" = dù rất muốn.

concession_contrast.q: ____ his many achievements, he remained modest.
concession_contrast.e: "For all + N" = dù có…

concession_contrast.q: ____ the weather may be, the race will take place.
concession_contrast.e: "Whatever + N + may be" = dù … thế nào.

concession_contrast.q: Try ____ she might, she couldn't remember his name.
concession_contrast.e: "Try as she might" = dù cố mấy.

concession_contrast.q: (A) Although (B) the rain, (C) we (D) went out.
concession_contrast.e: "Although" cần mệnh đề → "Despite the rain".

concession_contrast.q: (A) Despite of (B) his injury, (C) he (D) finished the race.
concession_contrast.e: "Despite" không có "of".

concession_contrast.q: (A) Although (B) she was tired, (C) but (D) she kept studying.
concession_contrast.e: Không dùng "although" và "but" cùng lúc.

concession_contrast.q: (A) In spite of (B) he worked hard, (C) he (D) failed the exam.
concession_contrast.e: "In spite of" cần danh từ → "Although".

concession_contrast.q: It was cold, but we went swimming.
o: Although it was cold, we went swimming.
Despite it was cold, we went swimming.
Although it was cold, but we went swimming.
However it was cold, we went swimming.
concession_contrast.e: "but" → "Although".

concession_contrast.q: Although he was ill, he came to work.
o: Despite being ill, he came to work.
Despite he was ill, he came to work.
Despite of being ill, he came to work.
Despite be ill, he came to work.
concession_contrast.e: "Although + clause" → "Despite + V-ing".

concession_contrast.q: Although the task was difficult, they finished it on time.
o: Difficult as the task was, they finished it on time.
Difficult although the task was, they finished it on time.
As difficult the task was, they finished it on time.
Difficult as was the task, they finished it on time.
concession_contrast.e: "Adj + as + S + V" (nhượng bộ).

concession_contrast.q: ____ it was pouring with rain, the marathon went ahead.
concession_contrast.e: Mệnh đề đầy đủ + nghĩa nhượng bộ → Although.
w: "However" không nối 2 mệnh đề như vậy

concession_contrast.q: ____ the high price, the concert tickets sold out in an hour.
concession_contrast.e: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ → Despite.

concession_contrast.q: She went to work ____ feeling unwell.
concession_contrast.e: in spite of + V-ing.

concession_contrast.q: The plan is risky. ____, we've decided to try it.
concession_contrast.e: Trạng từ nối đầu câu, tương phản → Nevertheless.
w: "Although" cần 2 mệnh đề trong cùng câu

concession_contrast.q: ____ carefully she checked the figures, she kept finding new errors.
concession_contrast.e: However + trạng từ + S + V = dù … đến đâu.
w: ✓ However carefully = dù kiểm tra kỹ đến đâu

concession_contrast.q: ____ the fact that he had no experience, he got the job.
concession_contrast.e: Despite the fact that + mệnh đề.
concession_contrast.r: despite the fact that + S + V

concession_contrast.q: (A) Despite of the rain, the match (B) went (C) ahead (D) as planned.
concession_contrast.e: "Despite" không đi với "of" → "Despite the rain" (hoặc "In spite of").

causative_verbs.q: I had my hair ____ yesterday.
causative_verbs.e: "have + vật + V3" = nhờ / thuê người làm (tóc được cắt) → "cut" (V3 của cut).
w: V-ing không dùng sau have + vật
"to V" không dùng sau have + vật
ĐT chia không đứng ở đây

causative_verbs.q: She got her car ____ at the garage.
causative_verbs.e: "get + O (vật) + V3" = nhờ / thuê người làm.
w: V nguyên mẫu dùng khi tân ngữ là người
"get + người + to V", đây là vật

causative_verbs.q: The teacher made us ____ the essay again.
causative_verbs.e: "make + O (người) + V nguyên mẫu" = bắt ai làm.
w: V-ing không dùng sau make + O

causative_verbs.q: I'll let you ____ when the food is ready.
causative_verbs.e: "let + O + V nguyên mẫu (không to)": "let you know" = báo cho bạn biết.

causative_verbs.q: I'll have the technician ____ your computer.
causative_verbs.e: "have + O (người) + V nguyên mẫu" = nhờ ai làm.
w: V3 dùng khi tân ngữ là vật
ĐT chia không đứng ở đây

causative_verbs.q: She got her brother ____ her move house.
