possessives_compound_nouns.q: The (A) children's (B) teacher (C) gave them (D) a two-hours test.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép trước danh từ: "a two-hour test" (hour số ít).

possessives_compound_nouns.q: (A) Yesterday's (B) newspaper (C) is on the (D) kitchen's table.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Bàn bếp là danh từ ghép: "kitchen table" (không dùng 's).

possessives_compound_nouns.q: This bike belongs to my brother.
o: This is bike of my brother's.
This is the bike my brother's.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: belong to + người = người + 's + vật.
w: thiếu mạo từ, sai cấu trúc

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The journey takes three hours.
o: It is a three hour's journey.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép: a three-hour journey (hour số ít, có gạch nối).

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The books belong to the students.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Nhiều học sinh → students' books.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: This is a shop that sells shoes.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Cửa hàng giày = danh từ ghép shoe shop (danh từ đầu số ít).
w: danh từ đầu để số ít

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The wedding of Lan and Minh was beautiful.
o: Lan and Minh's wedding was beautiful.
Lan's and Minh's wedding was beautiful.
Lan and Minh wedding was beautiful.
Lan's and Minh wedding was beautiful.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu chung → 's ở người sau: Lan and Minh's wedding.
possessives_compound_nouns.r: A and B's + N (sở hữu chung)

possessives_compound_nouns.q: This is my ____ car.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu của 1 người → "'s".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The ____ changing room is on the left.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Danh từ số nhiều bất quy tắc (women) → "'s".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: My ____ bedroom is bigger than mine.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu của số nhiều có -s → chỉ thêm "'".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: We stayed at a ____ hotel.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép số + N → N số ít, có gạch nối.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: I'll meet you in ____ time.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: "an hour's time" = trong 1 giờ nữa (sở hữu chỉ thời gian).

possessives_compound_nouns.q: That was ____ fault, not mine.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu chung của hai người → "'s" ở người sau.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: We bought a new ____.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Danh từ ghép: N + N (từ đầu số ít).

possessives_compound_nouns.q: It's a ____ walk from the station.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép trước N: "a ten-minute walk" (hoặc "ten minutes' walk").

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The (A) childrens' (B) toys (C) are (D) everywhere.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: "children" số nhiều bất quy tắc → "children's".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: We need a (A) new (B) tables (C) cloth (D) for the party.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Danh từ ghép: từ đầu số ít → "tablecloth".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The (A) car's (B) of (C) my neighbour (D) is red.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: → "My neighbour's car" ; câu lẫn 2 cấu trúc.
possessives_compound_nouns.r: N's N / the N of N

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The house belongs to my grandparents.
o: It is the house my grandparents'.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu số nhiều có -s → "'".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The journey takes two hours by train.
o: It's a two hour's train journey.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép số + N (số ít).

possessives_compound_nouns.q: This is ____ room — they share it.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu của danh từ số nhiều có -s (hai đứa sinh đôi) → chỉ thêm "'".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: Have you seen ____ new car? He only bought it last week.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tên riêng tận cùng -s vẫn thêm "'s" (James's) hoặc chỉ "'" (James').

possessives_compound_nouns.q: We need a new ____ for the kitchen.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Danh từ ghép: N (số ít) + N chính.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: Refunds are given at the ____ discretion.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu "'s": quyền quyết định của người quản lý.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: This is (A) my (B) brother's-in-law (C) house, (D) I think.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Danh từ ghép có gạch nối → "'s" ở cuối cả cụm: "brother-in-law's".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The meeting will be two weeks from now.
o: The meeting will be in two weeks' time.
The meeting will be in two week's time.
The meeting will be in two weeks time's.
The meeting will be in two-weeks time.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu chỉ thời gian, số nhiều → "two weeks' time".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The ____ shoes were left by the front door.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: "men" là số nhiều bất quy tắc (không có -s) → thêm 's: men's.
w: sai: đã là số nhiều, không thêm s'

possessives_compound_nouns.q: I'm staying at ____ house this weekend.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu của người → danh từ + 's.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: We need a new ____ for the office.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Danh từ ghép: danh từ thứ nhất làm "tính từ" (số ít, không 's).
w: danh từ đứng trước giữ số ít

possessives_compound_nouns.q: She's going on a ____ holiday.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép số + danh từ, có gạch nối → không thêm -s: a two-week holiday.
possessives_compound_nouns.r: số-danh từ (số ít) đứng trước danh từ
w: không thêm -s trong tính từ ghép

possessives_compound_nouns.q: Have you read ____ newspaper?
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu với từ chỉ thời gian: today's newspaper.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: ____ wedding was beautiful — they had been engaged for two years.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Một đám cưới CHUNG của hai người → chỉ thêm 's vào tên cuối.
possessives_compound_nouns.r: Sở hữu chung: A and B's
w: mỗi người 's riêng = 2 đám cưới riêng

possessives_compound_nouns.q: We stayed at a ____ hotel near the beach.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép số + danh từ → five-star (không -s).
possessives_compound_nouns.r: số-danh từ đứng trước danh từ

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The ____ changing room is next to the pool.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: "women" là số nhiều bất quy tắc → women's.

possessives_compound_nouns.q: Could you pass me the ____? I want to open these beans.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Danh từ ghép chỉ dụng cụ: tin opener.
w: danh từ đứng trước giữ số ít

possessives_compound_nouns.q: Let's meet at the ____ on the corner — it sells great bread.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: "the baker's" = tiệm bánh (cửa hàng, dùng 's như "the chemist's").

possessives_compound_nouns.q: This is (A) my (B) sisters (C) new (D) phone.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Sở hữu của chị / em gái (số ít) → "sister's".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: The (A) two-weeks (B) course (C) starts (D) on Monday.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: Tính từ ghép không thêm -s → "two-week".

possessives_compound_nouns.q: I found (A) the (B) cat's (C) toy under (D) the childrens' bed.
possessives_compound_nouns.e: "children" + 's → "the children's bed".

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ student in the class has a laptop.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Every + danh từ SỐ ÍT + động từ số ít (has).
determiners_all_each_every.r: every + N số ít + V số ít
w: both chỉ dùng cho 2 người / vật + N số nhiều

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of my friends live in Hanoi.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Most of + the / my + N số nhiều + V số nhiều (live).
determiners_all_each_every.r: most of + my / the + N số nhiều
w: each of đi với động từ số ít (lives)
almost là trạng từ, không đi với of

determiners_all_each_every.q: The teacher spoke to ____ student individually.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Từng người riêng lẻ (individually) + N số ít → each.
determiners_all_each_every.r: each + N số ít (từng cái một)
w: none không đứng trước danh từ

determiners_all_each_every.q: I invited ten people, but ____ of them came. It was so disappointing.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Thất vọng vì KHÔNG ai đến → none of them.
determiners_all_each_every.r: none of + N / them = không ai / không cái nào

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ the children were tired after the trip.
determiners_all_each_every.e: All + the + N số nhiều (were).

determiners_all_each_every.q: Not ____ student passed the test.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Not every + N số ít = không phải ai cũng…
w: not all cần N số nhiều (students)

determiners_all_each_every.q: She has read ____ book in the library. Amazing!
determiners_all_each_every.e: Every + N số ít: đọc hết mọi cuốn (Amazing!).
w: all cần N số nhiều / the
none không đứng trước danh từ

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of us knew the answer, so we asked the teacher.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Không ai biết → phải hỏi cô giáo: None of us.
determiners_all_each_every.r: none of us = không ai trong chúng tôi
w: most biết thì đã không cần hỏi

determiners_all_each_every.q: Yesterday it rained ____ day, so we stayed inside.
determiners_all_each_every.e: all day = suốt cả ngày (1 ngày hôm qua).
determiners_all_each_every.r: all day / all night = suốt cả ngày / đêm
w: every day = ngày nào cũng, mâu thuẫn với yesterday

determiners_all_each_every.q: The tickets cost $20 ____.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Mỗi vé 20 đô → each đứng cuối câu (= mỗi cái).

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ people like chocolate, but some don't.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Nói chung chung (không có the / my) → Most + N số nhiều.
determiners_all_each_every.r: most + N (nói chung) · most of + the / my + N
w: most of cần the / my phía sau
all of cần the phía sau và mâu thuẫn với "some don't"

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of the students has handed in the homework.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Động từ số ít (has) → Each of + N số nhiều + V số ít.
determiners_all_each_every.r: each of + N số nhiều + V số ít
w: all of đi với V số nhiều
most of đi với V số nhiều

determiners_all_each_every.q: We visit our grandparents ____ two weeks.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Tần suất "cứ 2 tuần một lần" → every two weeks.
determiners_all_each_every.r: every + số + N số nhiều = cứ … một lần
w: each không dùng với số kiểu này

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of the information was useful; we couldn't use any of it.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Không dùng được chút nào → None of the information.
determiners_all_each_every.r: none of + N không đếm được + V số ít

determiners_all_each_every.q: They ____ agreed with the plan.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Đại từ + all + động từ: They all agreed (tất cả họ đều đồng ý).
w: every không đứng sau đại từ
most không đứng sau đại từ
none không đứng sau đại từ

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Every students (B) in this school (C) wears (D) a uniform.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Every + danh từ số ít: "Every student".

determiners_all_each_every.q: She (A) has (B) visited every (C) countries (D) in Europe.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Every + N số ít: "every country".

determiners_all_each_every.q: The children (A) have (B) all of eaten (C) their lunch (D) already.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "all" đứng sau trợ động từ, không có "of": "have all eaten".
determiners_all_each_every.r: S + trợ động từ + all + V

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) None of my friends (B) has (C) a car, so we (D) all goes by bus.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Chủ ngữ "we" → "we all go".

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Each of the (B) rooms (C) have (D) a private bathroom.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Each of + N số nhiều + động từ SỐ ÍT: "has".
determiners_all_each_every.r: each of + N số nhiều + V số ít

determiners_all_each_every.q: Not one of the guests arrived on time.
o: None of the guests arrived on time.
All of the guests arrived on time.
Most of the guests arrived on time.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Không một vị khách nào = None of the guests.
w: every + N số ít, sai cả nghĩa

determiners_all_each_every.q: All the rooms in the hotel have a balcony.
o: Every room in the hotel has a balcony.
Every rooms in the hotel have a balcony.
Each rooms in the hotel has a balcony.
None of the rooms in the hotel has a balcony.
determiners_all_each_every.e: All the + N số nhiều = Every + N số ít + V số ít.

determiners_all_each_every.q: Almost all the students passed the exam.
o: Most of the students passed the exam.
Most students of the exam passed.
All of the students passed the exam.
None of the students passed the exam.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Hầu hết = Most of the + N số nhiều.

o: The bus comes every fifteen minutes.
The bus comes each fifteen minutes.
The bus comes all fifteen minutes.
The bus comes most fifteen minutes.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Cứ 15 phút một chuyến = every fifteen minutes.
w: each không dùng với số kiểu này

determiners_all_each_every.q: Each player gets a T-shirt.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Each player = Every player (+ N số ít, V số ít).
determiners_all_each_every.r: each / every + N số ít + V số ít

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ seat on the train was taken, so we had to stand.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Every + N số ít" + V số ít (was).

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of the shops were closed because of the holiday.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "All of + N số nhiều + V số nhiều".

determiners_all_each_every.q: The buses run ____ ten minutes.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "every + số + N" = cứ mỗi.

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of the two candidates was given a chance to speak.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Each of" (dùng cho 2 trở lên); "every" không dùng với 2 / không đi với "of".

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ the cake was eaten in minutes.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "The whole of + N số ít" = toàn bộ.

determiners_all_each_every.q: Most ____ the guests left before midnight.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Most of + the + N".

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ people enjoy travelling.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Nói chung (không có "the") → "Most + N".
determiners_all_each_every.r: most + N (chung) / most of the + N

determiners_all_each_every.q: I've read ____ book on the list.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "every + N số ít".

determiners_all_each_every.q: We spent ____ day at the beach.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "the whole day" = cả ngày.

determiners_all_each_every.q: The children were given two sweets ____.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "each" đứng cuối câu = mỗi người.

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of the three proposals was accepted — they were all rejected.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "None of (≥ 3)".

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ single employee received a bonus.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "every single + N" (nhấn mạnh).

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ and every one of you deserves credit.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Thành ngữ "each and every" = từng người một.

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Every (B) students (C) must (D) bring a pen.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Every + N số ít" → "student".

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Each of (B) the players (C) have (D) a number on their shirt.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Each of" → động từ số ít "has".

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Most of (B) people (C) prefer (D) working from home.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Nói chung → "Most people" (không "of").

determiners_all_each_every.q: All the rooms have a balcony.
o: Every of the rooms has a balcony.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "All + N số nhiều" → "Every + N số ít + V số ít".
determiners_all_each_every.r: every + N số ít + V số ít

determiners_all_each_every.q: The whole team was excited.
o: All of the team was excited.
Every of the team was excited.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "the whole + N" = "all (of) the + N".

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ student in the class received a certificate.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Danh từ số ít "student" + động từ số ít → Every.

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of my friends live in the city centre.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Most of + danh từ số nhiều" + động từ số nhiều (live).
w: "much" cho danh từ không đếm được

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of the two candidates gave a short speech.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Each of + 2 người trở lên"; "every" không đi với "of"; với 2 người không dùng "all / none".
determiners_all_each_every.r: each of + danh từ số nhiều

determiners_all_each_every.q: I've invited ten people, but ____ of them has replied yet.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "none of + them" = không ai trong số họ.
determiners_all_each_every.r: none of + đại từ / danh từ xác định
w: "any" sai nghĩa ở câu khẳng định

determiners_all_each_every.q: The guide gave the tourists a map ____.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "each" đứng cuối câu = mỗi người một tấm.

determiners_all_each_every.q: She visits her grandmother ____ other weekend.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "every other + danh từ số ít" = cách một (tuần thì đến).

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ the money was spent on new equipment.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "money" không đếm được → All (the money).
determiners_all_each_every.r: all + danh từ không đếm được
w: "every" cần danh từ đếm được số ít

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ of the information in the report was accurate.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "None of + danh từ không đếm được" + động từ số ít.

determiners_all_each_every.q: It rained ____ week, so we stayed indoors.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "the whole + danh từ số ít" = trọn cả.
determiners_all_each_every.r: the whole + danh từ số ít

determiners_all_each_every.q: ____ child needs love and attention.
determiners_all_each_every.e: Danh từ số ít "child" + động từ số ít "needs" → Each.

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Every (B) players (C) on the team (D) received a medal.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "every" + danh từ số ít → "player".

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Each of the rooms (B) has (C) their own (D) bathroom.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "Each of the rooms" là vật, số ít → "its own".

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) Most of people (B) in my town (C) speak (D) two languages.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "most" + danh từ chung (không "of") → "Most people".
determiners_all_each_every.r: most + N (chung) / most of the + N (xác định)

determiners_all_each_every.q: (A) All of the (B) staff (C) were invited, but (D) every of them declined.
determiners_all_each_every.e: "every" không đi với "of" → "every one of them" hoặc "each of them".
w: ✓ sai: phải là "every one of them"

dependent_prepositions.q: She is very good ____ maths.
dependent_prepositions.e: good at + môn / việc = giỏi về.
w: good for = tốt cho, sai nghĩa

dependent_prepositions.q: I'm interested ____ learning Japanese.
Are you afraid ____ spiders?
w: from sai (lỗi người Việt hay mắc)

dependent_prepositions.q: The final decision depends ____ the budget.
He apologised ____ being late.
dependent_prepositions.e: apologise (to sb) for + V-ing / N = xin lỗi vì.
dependent_prepositions.r: apologise for sth · apologise to sb
w: to dùng trước người, không trước lý do

dependent_prepositions.q: This bag belongs ____ my sister.
I'm looking forward ____ hearing from you.
dependent_prepositions.e: look forward to + V-ing (to là giới từ).

dependent_prepositions.q: She was very angry ____ me for breaking her phone.
dependent_prepositions.e: angry with + người · angry about + việc.
w: for đứng trước lý do, không trước người

dependent_prepositions.q: We need to find a solution ____ this problem.
Smoking is bad ____ your health.
dependent_prepositions.r: good / bad for + sức khoẻ, người
w: bad at = kém về, sai nghĩa

dependent_prepositions.q: There has been a sharp increase ____ prices this year.
dependent_prepositions.e: increase / rise / fall in + thứ thay đổi. (increase of + con số: an increase of 10%)

dependent_prepositions.q: The manager is responsible ____ hiring new staff.
dependent_prepositions.e: responsible for + V-ing / N = chịu trách nhiệm về.
w: to dùng trước người (responsible to the director)

dependent_prepositions.q: I'm not familiar ____ this software.
dependent_prepositions.r: sb is familiar with sth · sth is familiar to sb
w: familiar to dùng khi vật làm chủ ngữ

dependent_prepositions.q: Please concentrate ____ your work.
Thank you ____ your help.
dependent_prepositions.e: thank sb for sth = cảm ơn vì.

dependent_prepositions.q: Vietnam is famous ____ its street food.
She (A) is married (B) with (C) a doctor (D) from Hue.
(A) Many people (B) complained (C) for the noise (D) last night.
(A) Listen me carefully, (B) please, because (C) this is (D) important.
dependent_prepositions.e: listen to sb: "Listen to me carefully".

dependent_prepositions.q: I (A) am (B) not (C) very keen (D) in football.
dependent_prepositions.e: keen on = thích, say mê: "keen on football".

dependent_prepositions.q: Everyone (A) was surprised (B) of the news (C) that (D) she had quit.
dependent_prepositions.e: surprised at / by + N: "surprised at the news".

dependent_prepositions.q: Tom can cook very well.
dependent_prepositions.e: Nấu ăn giỏi = be good at cooking.
w: good for = tốt cho, sai nghĩa
well là trạng từ, không đứng sau be ở đây

dependent_prepositions.q: I am a fan of jazz music.
o: I am keen on jazz music.
I am keen in jazz music.
I am keen at jazz music.
I am keen to jazz music.
w: keen to + V = háo hức làm gì, không đi với danh từ

dependent_prepositions.q: The weather will decide whether we go or not.
o: Whether we go or not depends on the weather.
Whether we go or not depends of the weather.
Whether we go or not depends in the weather.
Whether we go or not depends from the weather.
dependent_prepositions.e: Thời tiết quyết định = phụ thuộc vào thời tiết: depend on.

dependent_prepositions.q: Spiders frighten my little sister.
o: My little sister is afraid of spiders.
My little sister is afraid from spiders.
My little sister is afraid with spiders.
My little sister is afraid about spiders.
dependent_prepositions.e: Làm sợ → sợ: be afraid of.

dependent_prepositions.q: She's very interested ____ photography.
I'm afraid ____ spiders.
It depends ____ the weather.
He's married ____ a doctor.
She's responsible ____ the marketing budget.
w: sai (responsible to = chịu trách nhiệm trước ai)

dependent_prepositions.q: I apologise ____ the delay.
The town is famous ____ its seafood.
Are you aware ____ the risks?
The price increase had a big effect ____ sales.
There's been a sharp rise ____ unemployment.
She insisted ____ paying for dinner.
I'm not used ____ working at weekends.
The decision was based ____ customer feedback.
He's very good ____ children.
dependent_prepositions.e: "good with (people / tools)" = khéo đối xử với.
dependent_prepositions.r: good with sb ≠ good at sth

dependent_prepositions.q: The new law is aimed ____ reducing pollution.
She was accused ____ lying under oath.
The museum is closed ____ renovation.
There is a growing demand ____ renewable energy.
The success of the plan is dependent ____ funding.
I'm (A) good (B) in (C) maths (D) and science.
She (A) congratulated (B) me (C) for (D) passing the exam.
(A) What's the reason (B) of (C) your (D) decision?
The company (A) has (B) a reputation (C) of (D) excellent service.
She is a skilful pianist.
o: She is good at playing the piano.
She is good in playing the piano.
She is good for playing the piano.
She is good with play the piano.

dependent_prepositions.q: He never pays attention when I speak.
My brother is very good ____ fixing computers.
w: "good for" = có lợi cho, sai nghĩa

dependent_prepositions.q: Lots of young people aren't interested ____ local politics.
The driver apologised ____ the delay.
The success of the project depends ____ good teamwork.
There has been a sharp rise ____ the cost of living.
dependent_prepositions.e: a rise / an increase in + thứ tăng lên (rise OF + con số).
dependent_prepositions.r: rise in + N ; rise of + số lượng
w: "of" đi với con số (a rise of 5%)

dependent_prepositions.q: Are you aware ____ the risks of this investment?
She (A) is (B) married (C) with (D) a doctor.

perfect_modals.q: The ground is wet. It ____ last night.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận chắc chắn về quá khứ (đất ướt) → must have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: must have V3 = chắc hẳn đã
w: ✓ suy luận chắc chắn về quá khứ
must + V = phải / chắc là (hiện tại), sai thời gian
should have V3 = lẽ ra nên, sai nghĩa
can't have V3 = không thể đã, ngược nghĩa

perfect_modals.q: You ____ me! I would have helped you.
perfect_modals.e: Trách nhẹ việc đã không làm → should have + V3 (lẽ ra nên).
perfect_modals.r: should have V3 = lẽ ra nên (nhưng đã không)
w: must have V3 = chắc hẳn đã, sai nghĩa
should + V = nên (hiện tại), sai thời gian
can have V3 không dùng trong câu khẳng định

perfect_modals.q: She ____ the email; she hasn't been online all day.
perfect_modals.e: Chắc chắn KHÔNG thể đã đọc (không online cả ngày) → can't have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: can't / couldn't have V3 = không thể đã

perfect_modals.q: I'm not sure where my keys are. I ____ them in the car.
perfect_modals.e: Không chắc → có lẽ đã: might have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: might / may / could have V3 = có lẽ đã
w: không thể đã, mâu thuẫn với "not sure"

perfect_modals.q: He failed the exam. He ____ harder.
perfect_modals.e: Lẽ ra nên học chăm hơn (nhưng đã không) → should have studied.
perfect_modals.r: should have V3 = lẽ ra nên
w: chắc hẳn đã học chăm, mâu thuẫn với trượt

perfect_modals.q: They're two hours late. They ____ the train.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận chắc chắn từ dấu hiệu (trễ 2 tiếng) → must have missed.
perfect_modals.r: must have V3 = chắc hẳn đã
w: lẽ ra nên lỡ tàu, vô lý

perfect_modals.q: You ____ so much food. Now we have lots left over.
perfect_modals.e: Lẽ ra không nên nấu nhiều vậy (đã nấu rồi) → shouldn't have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: shouldn't have V3 = lẽ ra không nên
w: mustn't have không dùng để trách
không thể đã nấu, mâu thuẫn

perfect_modals.q: It was a dangerous climb. You ____ killed!
perfect_modals.e: Điều có thể đã xảy ra nhưng không xảy ra → could have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: could have V3 = đã có thể (nhưng không)
w: chắc hẳn đã chết, vô lý
can have không dùng ở câu khẳng định

perfect_modals.q: Linh ____ the answer to yesterday's question — she's the best student in the class.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận chắc chắn về quá khứ → must have known.
perfect_modals.r: must have V3 = chắc hẳn đã

perfect_modals.q: I ____ to the party, but I was too tired.
perfect_modals.e: Đã có thể đi nhưng không đi (quá mệt) → could have gone.
perfect_modals.r: could have V3 = đã có thể (nhưng không)
w: chắc hẳn đã đi, mâu thuẫn
tự nói về mình, sai nghĩa

perfect_modals.q: There's no answer at the door. They ____ out.
perfect_modals.e: Không ai trả lời → chắc hẳn đã ra ngoài: must have gone.
perfect_modals.r: must have V3 = chắc hẳn đã
w: must + V = phải đi, sai nghĩa

perfect_modals.q: She ____ at home yesterday; I saw her at the cinema.
perfect_modals.e: Tôi thấy cô ấy ở rạp → không thể đã ở nhà: can't have been.
perfect_modals.r: can't have V3 = không thể đã
w: "có lẽ" mâu thuẫn với bằng chứng

perfect_modals.q: We ____ a taxi. The bus took two hours!
perfect_modals.e: Hối tiếc: lẽ ra nên đi taxi → should have taken.
perfect_modals.r: should have V3 = lẽ ra nên

perfect_modals.q: He must have ____ the wrong bus.
perfect_modals.e: must have + V3 → taken.
w: V nguyên mẫu không đi sau have

perfect_modals.q: I don't know why Mai is upset. Someone ____ something to her.
perfect_modals.e: Đoán, không chắc (I don't know why) → may have said.
perfect_modals.r: may / might have V3 = có lẽ đã

perfect_modals.q: You (A) should (B) have (C) came (D) to the meeting.
perfect_modals.e: should have + V3 → "come".

perfect_modals.q: The lights are off. They (A) must (B) went (C) to bed (D) early.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận về quá khứ → "must have gone".

perfect_modals.q: (A) He can have forgotten (B) about the meeting (C) because he (D) wrote it in his diary.
perfect_modals.e: Ghi vào sổ rồi → không thể đã quên: "He can't have forgotten".
perfect_modals.r: can't have V3 = không thể đã

perfect_modals.q: I (A) shouldn't (B) to have (C) eaten (D) so much cake.
perfect_modals.e: Sau modal không có "to": "shouldn't have eaten".

perfect_modals.q: We (A) could have (B) won the match (C) if Tom (D) has scored that goal.
perfect_modals.e: Điều kiện trái quá khứ → "if Tom had scored".
perfect_modals.r: could have V3 + if + had V3

perfect_modals.q: I'm sure Nam took my umbrella.
o: Nam must have taken my umbrella.
Nam should have taken my umbrella.
Nam can't have taken my umbrella.
perfect_modals.e: Chắc chắn đã làm = must have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: I'm sure + V2 = must have V3

perfect_modals.q: It was a mistake not to bring a map.
o: We should have brought a map.
We must have brought a map.
We shouldn't have brought a map.
We can't have brought a map.
perfect_modals.e: Không mang là sai lầm = lẽ ra nên mang: should have brought.
perfect_modals.r: should have V3 = lẽ ra nên
w: chắc hẳn đã mang, sai nghĩa

perfect_modals.q: I'm sure she didn't say that.
perfect_modals.e: Chắc chắn đã không = can't have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: I'm sure … didn't = can't have V3
w: lẽ ra không nên, sai nghĩa

perfect_modals.q: Perhaps Tom forgot about our meeting.
o: Tom might have forgotten about our meeting.
Tom must have forgotten about our meeting.
Tom should have forgotten about our meeting.
Tom can't have forgotten about our meeting.
perfect_modals.e: Perhaps + V2 = might / may have + V3.

perfect_modals.q: It was possible for you to hurt yourself, but you didn't.
perfect_modals.e: Đã có thể xảy ra nhưng không = could have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: could have V3 = đã có thể (nhưng không)
w: chắc hẳn đã bị thương, sai

perfect_modals.q: The streets are covered in snow. It ____ overnight.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận chắc chắn về quá khứ (có dấu hiệu) → "must have V3".
perfect_modals.r: must have V3 = chắc hẳn đã
w: "should have" = đáng lẽ nên, sai nghĩa

perfect_modals.q: You ____ me you were coming — I'd have made dinner.
perfect_modals.e: Trách nhẹ: đáng lẽ nên làm (nhưng không làm) → "should have V3".

perfect_modals.q: She ____ the email — she replied to it an hour ago.
perfect_modals.e: Có bằng chứng (đã trả lời) → chắc chắn đã đọc.

perfect_modals.q: He ____ the exam — he didn't study at all.
perfect_modals.e: Chắc chắn KHÔNG → "can't have V3".

perfect_modals.q: I'm not sure where my keys are. I ____ them at work.
perfect_modals.e: Phỏng đoán không chắc → "might / may / could have V3".

perfect_modals.q: We ____ a taxi — the station was only five minutes away.
perfect_modals.e: Đã làm nhưng không cần thiết → "needn't have V3".

perfect_modals.q: You ____ killed! Why did you drive so fast?
perfect_modals.e: Điều có thể đã xảy ra (nhưng không xảy ra) → "could have V3".

perfect_modals.q: They ____ arrived by now — their flight landed at six.
perfect_modals.e: "should have V3" = lẽ ra (theo dự tính) đã…

perfect_modals.q: I ____ so rude to her. I feel terrible now.
perfect_modals.e: Hối tiếc: đáng lẽ không nên → "shouldn't have V3".

perfect_modals.q: She ____ seen me — she walked straight past.
perfect_modals.e: Đi lướt qua → chắc chắn không thấy. — "must not have" (Mỹ) không có trong phương án

perfect_modals.q: The thief ____ in through the window; it was locked from inside.
perfect_modals.e: Không thể có khả năng → "couldn't have V3".

perfect_modals.q: You ____ worried — everything went perfectly.
perfect_modals.e: Đã lo nhưng không cần → "needn't have worried".

perfect_modals.q: He ____ the message, or he would have called back.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận ngược (nếu nhận thì đã gọi lại) → chắc chắn chưa nhận.

perfect_modals.q: It ____ easy for her to leave her family behind.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận "chắc là không dễ" → "can't have been".

perfect_modals.q: They (A) should (B) have (C) went (D) home earlier.
perfect_modals.e: "should have + V3" → "gone".

perfect_modals.q: She (A) must (B) has (C) forgotten (D) about the meeting.
perfect_modals.e: Sau modal là "have" (không chia): "must have".

perfect_modals.q: He (A) can't (B) have (C) stole (D) the money.
perfect_modals.e: "have + V3" → "stolen".

perfect_modals.q: We (A) needn't (B) to have (C) hurried — the train (D) was late.
perfect_modals.e: "needn't have V3" (không có "to").

perfect_modals.q: I'm sure she was at home — her car was outside.
o: She must have been at home.
She should have been at home.
She can't have been at home.
perfect_modals.e: Chắc chắn đã… → "must have been".

perfect_modals.q: It was a mistake not to book a table.
o: We should have booked a table.
We must have booked a table.
We needn't have booked a table.
perfect_modals.e: Tiếc vì không làm → "should have V3".

perfect_modals.q: It wasn't necessary to bring food, but we did.
o: We didn't need to bring food, so we didn't.
perfect_modals.e: Đã làm nhưng không cần → "needn't have V3".

perfect_modals.q: The lights are off and nobody answers the door. They ____ out.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận chắc chắn về việc đã xảy ra → must have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: must have V3 = chắc hẳn đã
w: hiện tại = bắt buộc, sai nghĩa
"can have" không dùng để suy đoán khẳng định

perfect_modals.q: You ____ me you were coming — I would have cooked more food.
perfect_modals.e: Trách nhẹ: lẽ ra nên nói (mà không nói) → should have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: should have V3 = lẽ ra nên

perfect_modals.q: She ____ the email; she's been offline all day.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận chắc chắn KHÔNG xảy ra → can't have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: can't have V3 = không thể nào đã
w: "mustn't have" không dùng để suy đoán

perfect_modals.q: I'm not sure where my keys are. I ____ them at the office.
perfect_modals.e: Không chắc → might have + V3 (có lẽ đã).
perfect_modals.r: might / may have V3 = có lẽ đã

perfect_modals.q: We ____ a taxi. The bus was much quicker.
perfect_modals.e: Đã làm nhưng hoá ra không cần → needn't have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: needn't have V3 = lẽ ra không cần

perfect_modals.q: He ____ the accident if he had been paying attention.
perfect_modals.e: Khả năng trong quá khứ đã không xảy ra (điều kiện loại 3) → could have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: could have V3 = lẽ ra đã có thể

perfect_modals.q: They ____ lost — they've been here many times before.
perfect_modals.e: Suy luận chắc chắn không xảy ra → can't have + V3.
w: "must have got lost" mâu thuẫn "been here many times"

perfect_modals.q: You ____ that rude comment. Now she's upset.
perfect_modals.e: Trách việc đã làm → shouldn't have + V3.
perfect_modals.r: shouldn't have V3 = lẽ ra không nên
w: "can't have" = không thể nào đã, sai nghĩa

perfect_modals.q: We (A) could (B) have (C) took (D) the earlier train.
perfect_modals.e: Sau "have" cần V3 → "taken".

perfect_modals.q: They (A) might (B) has (C) missed (D) the last bus.
perfect_modals.e: Sau modal dùng nguyên mẫu "have" → "might have missed".

perfect_modals.q: I can't find my phone. (A) I think I (B) must leave it (C) in the taxi (D) this morning.
perfect_modals.e: Suy đoán về quá khứ ("this morning") → "must have left it".
w: ✓ sai: phải là "must have left it"

had_better_would_rather.q: You look ill. You'd better ____ a doctor.
had_better_would_rather.e: had better + V nguyên mẫu (không to).
w: không có to sau had better

had_better_would_rather.q: It's late. We'd better ____, or we'll miss the last bus.
had_better_would_rather.e: 'd better = had better + V nguyên mẫu.

had_better_would_rather.q: You ____ better not tell anyone about this.
had_better_would_rather.e: Cấu trúc cố định: had better (not) + V.

had_better_would_rather.q: I'd rather ____ at home tonight.
had_better_would_rather.e: would rather + V nguyên mẫu (không to).
w: V2 chỉ dùng khi có chủ ngữ khác (I'd rather you stayed)

had_better_would_rather.q: I'd rather you ____ smoke in here.
had_better_would_rather.e: would rather + người khác + V2 (giả định, nghĩa hiện tại): I'd rather you didn't…

had_better_would_rather.q: Would you rather have tea ____ coffee?
had_better_would_rather.e: Câu hỏi lựa chọn: Would you rather A or B?
had_better_would_rather.r: Would you rather A or B?
w: than dùng trong câu khẳng định (I'd rather A than B)

had_better_would_rather.q: I'd rather walk ____ take the bus.
had_better_would_rather.e: would rather A than B (cả hai V nguyên mẫu).

had_better_would_rather.q: It's time we ____ home.
had_better_would_rather.e: It's time + S + V2 (đáng lẽ phải làm rồi).

had_better_would_rather.q: It's time ____ to bed, kids!
had_better_would_rather.e: It's time + to V (không có chủ ngữ).

had_better_would_rather.q: It's high time you ____ a job.
had_better_would_rather.e: It's high time + S + V2.

had_better_would_rather.q: You're supposed ____ your seatbelt in the car.
had_better_would_rather.e: be supposed to + V = phải (theo quy định).

had_better_would_rather.q: The film ____ to be very good, but I didn't like it.
had_better_would_rather.e: be supposed to = được cho là (người ta nói vậy).
had_better_would_rather.r: be supposed to = được cho là

had_better_would_rather.q: We ____ supposed to use our phones during the exam.
had_better_would_rather.e: Phủ định: be not supposed to = không được phép.

had_better_would_rather.q: I'd prefer ____ by train.
had_better_would_rather.e: would prefer + to V (khác would rather + V).
had_better_would_rather.r: would prefer + to V · would rather + V

had_better_would_rather.q: You had better ____ late again, or the boss will be angry.
had_better_would_rather.e: Phủ định: had better not + V.
w: don't không dùng sau had better

had_better_would_rather.q: You (A) had (B) better (C) to finish (D) your report before Friday.
had_better_would_rather.e: had better + V nguyên mẫu → "finish".

had_better_would_rather.q: (A) It's time we (B) leave, (C) or we'll be (D) late for the concert.
had_better_would_rather.e: It's time + S + V2 → "left".

had_better_would_rather.q: (A) I'd rather to stay (B) at home (C) than (D) go to the party.
had_better_would_rather.e: would rather + V nguyên mẫu (không to): "I'd rather stay".

had_better_would_rather.q: This medicine (A) is supposed (B) to (C) be taken (D) after eat.
had_better_would_rather.e: Sau giới từ after dùng V-ing / danh từ: "after eating" / "after meals".

had_better_would_rather.q: It's (A) high time (B) the children (C) go (D) to bed.
had_better_would_rather.e: It's high time + S + V2 → "went".

had_better_would_rather.q: I think it's a good idea for you to rest.
had_better_would_rather.e: Khuyên = had better + V.
w: would rather = thích hơn, sai nghĩa

had_better_would_rather.q: I prefer staying in to going out tonight.
o: I'd rather stay in than go out tonight.
I'd rather to stay in than go out tonight.
I'd rather staying in than going out tonight.
I'd better stay in than go out tonight.
had_better_would_rather.e: prefer V-ing to V-ing = would rather V than V.
w: had better không đi với than

had_better_would_rather.q: You should start revising now.
o: It's time you will start revising.
had_better_would_rather.e: Đã đến lúc phải làm = It's time + S + V2.

had_better_would_rather.q: The rules say we must wear a helmet.
o: We are supposed to wear a helmet.
We suppose to wear a helmet.
We are supposed wearing a helmet.
We would rather wear a helmet.
had_better_would_rather.e: Theo quy định phải = be supposed to + V.
w: would rather = thích hơn, sai nghĩa

had_better_would_rather.q: Please don't open the window.
o: I'd rather you didn't open the window.
I'd rather you don't opened the window.
I'd rather you not to open the window.
I'd better you didn't open the window.
had_better_would_rather.e: Yêu cầu lịch sự = I'd rather + S + V2 (didn't + V).
w: had better không đi với chủ ngữ khác

had_better_would_rather.q: You'd better ____ an umbrella. It's going to rain.
had_better_would_rather.e: "had better + V nguyên mẫu".

had_better_would_rather.q: I'm tired. I'd rather ____ a film than go to the party.
had_better_would_rather.e: "would rather + V nguyên mẫu (+ than + V)".

had_better_would_rather.q: We ____ to wear a uniform, but nobody does.
had_better_would_rather.e: "be supposed to" = lẽ ra phải (quy định).

had_better_would_rather.q: You'd better ____ late again, or you'll lose your job.
had_better_would_rather.e: Phủ định: "had better not + V".

had_better_would_rather.q: Most people would rather rent a flat ____ share a house.
had_better_would_rather.e: "would rather A than B".

had_better_would_rather.q: I'd rather you ____ your phone during dinner.
had_better_would_rather.e: "would rather + S + V2" (hiện tại).

had_better_would_rather.q: It's time we ____ the problem seriously.
had_better_would_rather.e: "It's time + S + V2".

had_better_would_rather.q: It's time ____ a decision — we can't wait any longer.
had_better_would_rather.e: "It's time + to V".

had_better_would_rather.q: You were supposed to call me yesterday. Why ____?
had_better_would_rather.e: Câu hỏi: "Why didn't you (call)?".

had_better_would_rather.q: The film ____ to be really good, but I found it boring.
had_better_would_rather.e: "be supposed to" = được cho là.

had_better_would_rather.q: It's high time the government ____ action on housing.
had_better_would_rather.e: "It's high time + S + V2".

had_better_would_rather.q: We ____ better leave now if we want to beat the traffic.
had_better_would_rather.e: "had better + V".

had_better_would_rather.q: Passengers are not supposed ____ in the toilets.
had_better_would_rather.e: "be (not) supposed to + V".

had_better_would_rather.q: You (A) had (B) better (C) to see (D) a doctor.
had_better_would_rather.e: "had better + V" → "see".

had_better_would_rather.q: I'd rather (A) to stay (B) in (C) than (D) go out.
had_better_would_rather.e: "would rather + V" → "stay".

had_better_would_rather.q: It's time (A) we (B) leave (C) for (D) the airport.
had_better_would_rather.e: "It's time + S + V2" → "left".

had_better_would_rather.q: You'd (A) better (B) not (C) to forget (D) your passport.
had_better_would_rather.e: "had better not + V".

had_better_would_rather.q: I prefer tea to coffee.
o: I'd rather have tea than coffee.
I'd rather to have tea than coffee.
I'd rather having tea than coffee.
I'd rather have tea that coffee.
had_better_would_rather.e: "would rather + V + than".

had_better_would_rather.q: You should leave now or you'll miss the train.
o: You'd better leave now or you'll miss the train.
You'd better to leave now or you'll miss the train.
You'd better leaving now or you'll miss the train.
You'd rather leave now or you'll miss the train.
had_better_would_rather.e: Khuyên mạnh, có hậu quả → "had better".

had_better_would_rather.q: The meeting should have started at nine.
o: The meeting was supposed to start at nine.
The meeting was supposed start at nine.
The meeting supposed to start at nine.
The meeting was supposing to start at nine.
had_better_would_rather.e: "should have started" (lẽ ra) → "was supposed to".

had_better_would_rather.q: You ____ book a table now. That restaurant is always full on Fridays.
had_better_would_rather.e: Lời khuyên mạnh → had better + V.

had_better_would_rather.q: I'm tired. I'd rather ____ a film at home than go to the party.
had_better_would_rather.e: would rather + V nguyên mẫu (không "to"), song song với "go".
w: quá khứ chỉ dùng khi có chủ ngữ khác

had_better_would_rather.q: It's high time we ____ home.
had_better_would_rather.e: It's (high) time + S + quá khứ = đã đến lúc (lẽ ra phải làm rồi).

had_better_would_rather.q: You're supposed to ____ your phone off during the exam.
had_better_would_rather.e: be supposed to + V = phải / được yêu cầu làm.

had_better_would_rather.q: We'd better not ____ late for the interview.
had_better_would_rather.e: had better not + V nguyên mẫu.

had_better_would_rather.q: My boss would rather we ____ personal calls during working hours.
had_better_would_rather.e: would rather + S khác + quá khứ (phủ định: didn't + V).

had_better_would_rather.q: The train ____ arrive at 6, but it's already 6:30.
had_better_would_rather.e: Lẽ ra phải (nhưng không xảy ra) → was supposed to.
had_better_would_rather.r: was supposed to + V = lẽ ra phải

had_better_would_rather.q: Would you rather ____ by train or by plane?
had_better_would_rather.e: Would you rather + V nguyên mẫu …?

had_better_would_rather.q: It's time ____ for the airport.
had_better_would_rather.e: It's time + to V = đến lúc làm gì.
w: quá khứ cần chủ ngữ (It's time we left)

had_better_would_rather.q: You (A) had better (B) to see (C) a doctor (D) about that cough.
had_better_would_rather.e: had better + V nguyên mẫu (không "to") → "see".

had_better_would_rather.q: (A) I'd rather walk (B) than take a taxi, (C) but my friends (D) would rather to drive.
had_better_would_rather.e: would rather + V (không "to") → "would rather drive".

had_better_would_rather.q: We (A) are suppose to (B) hand in (C) the report (D) by Friday.
had_better_would_rather.e: "be supposed to" có -d → "are supposed to".

conditional_variants.q: ____ you hurry, you'll miss the train.
conditional_variants.e: Unless = if … not: Nếu không nhanh lên thì sẽ lỡ tàu.
conditional_variants.r: Unless + khẳng định = If + phủ định
w: If you hurry … miss: vô lý
in case = phòng khi, sai nghĩa

conditional_variants.q: Take an umbrella ____ it rains.
conditional_variants.e: in case = phòng khi (chuẩn bị trước).
conditional_variants.r: in case + hiện tại đơn = phòng khi
w: provided that = miễn là, sai nghĩa
otherwise không nối mệnh đề kiểu này

conditional_variants.q: You can borrow my car ____ you drive carefully.
conditional_variants.e: provided that = với điều kiện là.
conditional_variants.r: provided (that) / as long as = miễn là

conditional_variants.q: Write it down; ____ you'll forget it.
conditional_variants.e: otherwise = nếu không thì.
w: unless đứng trước điều kiện, không trước kết quả

conditional_variants.q: I'll lend you the money ____ you pay me back next week.
conditional_variants.e: as long as = miễn là.
conditional_variants.r: as long as + hiện tại đơn

conditional_variants.q: ____ I known about the problem, I would have helped.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + V3.
conditional_variants.r: Had + S + V3, S + would have V3

conditional_variants.q: ____ you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact us.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ loại 1 (trang trọng): Should + S + V.
w: Were cần to V / tính từ

conditional_variants.q: ____ she the manager, she would change the working hours.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ loại 2: Were + S + …

conditional_variants.q: ____ your help, I couldn't have finished the project.
conditional_variants.e: Without + danh từ = nếu không có.
conditional_variants.r: Without / But for + N = If it hadn't been for

conditional_variants.q: ____ it not been for the rain, we would have gone to the beach.
conditional_variants.e: Had it not been for + N = nếu không vì.
conditional_variants.r: Had it not been for + N, … would have V3

conditional_variants.q: We'll go for a picnic tomorrow, ____ it rains.
conditional_variants.e: Sẽ đi trừ khi trời mưa → unless.
w: phòng khi trời mưa thì đi picnic, vô lý
miễn là trời mưa, vô lý

conditional_variants.q: I'll bring some snacks ____ we get hungry.
conditional_variants.e: Mang sẵn đồ ăn phòng khi đói → in case.

conditional_variants.q: Suppose you ____ the lottery, what would you do?
conditional_variants.e: Suppose (= giả sử) + V2 khi vế sau là would → điều kiện loại 2.
w: hiện tại không hợp với would
loại 3 không hợp với would do

conditional_variants.q: ____ you follow the instructions, the machine is easy to use.
conditional_variants.e: Miễn là làm theo hướng dẫn → As long as.

conditional_variants.q: She studied hard; ____, she would have failed.
conditional_variants.e: Đã học chăm; nếu không thì đã trượt → otherwise + would have V3.

conditional_variants.q: (A) Unless you (B) don't (C) study, you (D) will fail.
conditional_variants.e: Unless đã mang nghĩa phủ định → bỏ "don't": "Unless you study".

conditional_variants.q: (A) In case of it rains, (B) the match (C) will be (D) cancelled.
conditional_variants.e: "in case of" + danh từ (in case of rain); nghĩa "nếu" → "If it rains".
conditional_variants.r: in case of + N · If + mệnh đề

conditional_variants.q: (A) Had I (B) knew (C) the truth, I (D) would have told you.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ loại 3: Had + S + V3 → "known".

conditional_variants.q: (A) Were I (B) you, I (C) will (D) apologise to her.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ loại 2 → vế chính dùng "would".
conditional_variants.r: Were I you, I would + V

conditional_variants.q: You can stay (A) here (B) as long (C) as you (D) will be quiet.
conditional_variants.e: Sau as long as (mệnh đề điều kiện) dùng hiện tại đơn: "are quiet".
conditional_variants.r: as long as + hiện tại đơn

conditional_variants.q: If you don't leave now, you'll be late.
o: Unless you leave now, you'll be late.
Unless you don't leave now, you'll be late.
In case you leave now, you'll be late.
Provided you leave now, you'll be late.
conditional_variants.e: If … not = Unless + khẳng định.

conditional_variants.q: If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
o: Had I seen him, I would have said hello.
Had I saw him, I would have said hello.
Did I see him, I would have said hello.
Have I seen him, I would have said hello.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ loại 3: bỏ If, đưa Had lên đầu.
w: Did không dùng đảo ngữ điều kiện

conditional_variants.q: Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
o: If you don't hurry up, you'll miss the bus.
If you hurry up, you'll miss the bus.
Unless you don't hurry up, you'll miss the bus.
In case you hurry up, you'll miss the bus.
conditional_variants.e: Mệnh lệnh + or = If … not …

conditional_variants.q: If it hadn't been for your advice, I would have made a mistake.
o: But for your advice, I would have made a mistake.
Because of your advice, I would have made a mistake.
Unless your advice, I would have made a mistake.
In case of your advice, I would have made a mistake.
conditional_variants.e: If it hadn't been for + N = But for / Without + N.
conditional_variants.r: But for + N = nếu không có

conditional_variants.q: If you should see Anna, tell her to call me.
o: Should you see Anna, tell her to call me.
Should you saw Anna, tell her to call me.
Unless you see Anna, tell her to call me.
Had you seen Anna, tell her to call me.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ loại 1: Should + S + V.
w: sau Should dùng V nguyên mẫu

conditional_variants.q: You won't pass ____ you study harder.
conditional_variants.e: "unless" = if not: sẽ không đỗ nếu không học chăm hơn.

conditional_variants.q: Write down my number ____ you get lost.
conditional_variants.e: "in case" = phòng khi.

conditional_variants.q: Hurry up, ____ we'll miss the bus.
conditional_variants.e: "otherwise" = nếu không thì.

conditional_variants.q: You can borrow my car ____ you bring it back by six.
conditional_variants.e: "provided (that)" = với điều kiện là.

conditional_variants.q: You can stay with us ____ you don't mind sleeping on the sofa.
conditional_variants.e: "as long as" = miễn là.
conditional_variants.r: as long as / so long as = miễn là

conditional_variants.q: ____ you hadn't reminded me, I would have forgotten.
conditional_variants.e: Loại 3 phủ định → dùng "If … hadn't" (không dùng "unless" cho điều kiện trái quá khứ kiểu này).
w: "unless" không dùng với giả định trái quá khứ

conditional_variants.q: ____ it rains or not, the match will go ahead.
conditional_variants.e: "Whether … or not" = dù có… hay không.
w: "If … or not" không đứng đầu câu

conditional_variants.q: I'll keep my phone on ____ you need to contact me.
conditional_variants.e: "in case" = phòng khi.

conditional_variants.q: ____ you were offered the job, would you take it?
conditional_variants.e: "Supposing / Suppose (that)" = giả sử.

conditional_variants.q: I'm going to the beach tomorrow ____ it's cold — I don't care about the weather.
conditional_variants.e: "even if" = ngay cả khi ("I don't care about the weather").
w: trái với "I don't care about the weather"

conditional_variants.q: ____ no one objects, the meeting will be moved to Friday.
conditional_variants.e: "Providing (that)" = với điều kiện. — "Unless no one objects" sai nghĩa (phủ định kép).

conditional_variants.q: ____ you change your mind, the offer is open until Friday.
conditional_variants.e: "In the event that" = trong trường hợp (trang trọng). — "In case you change your mind" cũng đúng nhưng không có

conditional_variants.q: But ____ your quick thinking, the accident would have been much worse.
conditional_variants.e: "But for + N" = nếu không có (trang trọng).
conditional_variants.r: but for + N = if it hadn't been for

conditional_variants.q: (A) Unless (B) you don't (C) hurry, (D) you'll be late.
conditional_variants.e: "Unless" đã mang nghĩa phủ định → "Unless you hurry".

conditional_variants.q: Take a jacket (A) in case (B) it (C) will get (D) cold later.
conditional_variants.e: Sau "in case" dùng hiện tại đơn: "it gets".

conditional_variants.q: (A) Provided (B) that you (C) will finish your work, (D) you can leave early.
conditional_variants.e: Sau "provided that" dùng hiện tại đơn: "finish".

conditional_variants.q: If you don't leave now, you'll miss the train.
o: Unless you leave now, you'll miss the train.
Unless you don't leave now, you'll miss the train.
In case you leave now, you'll miss the train.
Unless you will leave now, you'll miss the train.
conditional_variants.e: if … not = unless.

conditional_variants.q: Save your work regularly. If you don't, you might lose it.
o: Save your work regularly, otherwise you might lose it.
Save your work regularly, unless you might lose it.
Save your work regularly, in case you might lose it.
Save your work regularly, if not you lose it.
conditional_variants.e: "If you don't" = "otherwise".
w: "in case" không đi với "might" ở đây

conditional_variants.q: If it hadn't been for the map, we would have got lost.
o: But for the map, we would have got lost.
But for the map, we would get lost.
Unless the map, we would have got lost.
But the map, we would have got lost.
conditional_variants.e: "If it hadn't been for + N" = "But for + N".

conditional_variants.q: ____ you leave now, you'll miss the train.
conditional_variants.e: Unless = If … not: nếu không đi bây giờ thì sẽ lỡ tàu.
w: "If you leave now" mâu thuẫn "miss the train"

conditional_variants.q: Save your work regularly ____ the computer crashes.
conditional_variants.e: Phòng khi máy bị treo → in case.

conditional_variants.q: Visitors may use the pool ____ they are accompanied by a member.
conditional_variants.e: Với điều kiện là có hội viên đi cùng → provided that.
w: "otherwise" không nối mệnh đề điều kiện

conditional_variants.q: We must hurry; ____, we'll be late.
conditional_variants.e: Nếu không (vội) thì sẽ muộn → otherwise.

conditional_variants.q: ____ the weather is fine, the concert will be held outdoors.
conditional_variants.e: Miễn là trời đẹp → As long as.
w: "otherwise" không đứng đầu mệnh đề điều kiện

conditional_variants.q: ____ you require further information, please contact our office.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1 (văn trang trọng): Should + S + V = If you require.

conditional_variants.q: ____ for your help, I wouldn't have finished on time.
conditional_variants.e: Đảo ngữ loại 3: Had it not been for = If it hadn't been for.
conditional_variants.r: Had it not been for + N, would have V3

conditional_variants.q: I'll lend you the money ____ you pay me back by Friday.
conditional_variants.e: Với điều kiện → on condition that.

conditional_variants.q: I'm going to the beach ____ it rains — nothing will stop me!
conditional_variants.e: Ngay cả khi mưa vẫn đi → even if.

conditional_variants.q: ____ you hear from her, let me know.
conditional_variants.e: Điều kiện thường: nếu nghe tin → If.
w: "otherwise" không đứng đầu mệnh đề điều kiện

conditional_variants.q: (A) Unless you (B) don't (C) study harder, you (D) will fail the exam.
conditional_variants.e: "Unless" đã mang nghĩa phủ định → bỏ "don't".

conditional_variants.q: Let's (A) buy (B) extra water (C) in case the shops (D) will be closed.
conditional_variants.e: Sau "in case" dùng hiện tại đơn → "are closed".

conditional_variants.q: (A) Provided (B) that the funds (C) will be approved, work (D) will begin in May.
conditional_variants.e: Mệnh đề điều kiện dùng hiện tại → "are approved".

ellipsis_substitution.q: Is it going to rain? — I hope ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay cả mệnh đề phủ định sau hope → I hope not.
ellipsis_substitution.r: I hope so / I hope not · I'm afraid so / not
w: thiếu chủ ngữ và động từ

ellipsis_substitution.q: Is Minh joining us for dinner? — I think ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay mệnh đề khẳng định sau think → I think so.

ellipsis_substitution.q: I don't like this shirt. Can I see a different ____?
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay danh từ đếm được số ít đã nói (shirt) → one.
w: it = chính cái áo này, sai nghĩa
other không đứng sau a different

ellipsis_substitution.q: These shoes are too small. Do you have bigger ____?
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay danh từ số nhiều (shoes) → ones.

ellipsis_substitution.q: He was asked to leave the room, and he did ____ immediately.
ellipsis_substitution.e: do so = làm đúng việc đó (thay cụm động từ "leave the room", văn trang trọng).
ellipsis_substitution.r: do so = thay cụm động từ vừa nói
w: such không thay cụm động từ
one thay danh từ, không thay động từ

ellipsis_substitution.q: I can't swim, and neither ____ my brother.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Lặp trợ động từ của vế trước (can't) → neither can.
w: neither đã mang nghĩa phủ định

ellipsis_substitution.q: She wanted to leave early, but she wasn't allowed ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tỉnh lược: giữ "to", bỏ phần lặp (to leave early).
ellipsis_substitution.r: … allowed / want / hope to (bỏ V lặp)

ellipsis_substitution.q: Are you coming with us? — I'd love ____, but I'm busy.
ellipsis_substitution.e: I'd love to (bỏ "come with you").

ellipsis_substitution.q: Do you think the shop is open? — I'm afraid ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay mệnh đề phủ định sau I'm afraid → I'm afraid not.

ellipsis_substitution.q: The climate of Da Lat is cooler than ____ of Ho Chi Minh City.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay danh từ không đếm được / số ít đã nói (the climate) trong so sánh → that of.
ellipsis_substitution.r: that of (số ít) · those of (số nhiều)
w: one không đi với of ở đây

ellipsis_substitution.q: The prices this year are higher than ____ last year.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay danh từ số nhiều (the prices) → those.
ellipsis_substitution.r: those (of) thay danh từ số nhiều
w: ones không đứng một mình kiểu này

ellipsis_substitution.q: You don't have to come, but you can if you ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tỉnh lược: if you want to (come).

ellipsis_substitution.q: Tom has finished his homework, but Mai ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Lặp trợ động từ của vế trước (has finished) → hasn't.
ellipsis_substitution.r: Lặp trợ động từ thay cụm động từ

ellipsis_substitution.q: He promised to call me, but he never ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay "called me" bằng trợ động từ quá khứ → did.
ellipsis_substitution.r: Trợ động từ thay cụm động từ

ellipsis_substitution.q: Has the meeting been cancelled? — It ____ so.
ellipsis_substitution.e: It seems / appears so = có vẻ là vậy.
ellipsis_substitution.r: It seems so · It appears so
w: looks like không đi với so

ellipsis_substitution.q: These apples are (A) sweeter (B) than (C) the ones (D) we bought it last week.
ellipsis_substitution.e: "the ones" đã thay cho táo → bỏ "it": "the ones we bought last week".
ellipsis_substitution.r: the ones (that) + S + V (không lặp tân ngữ)

ellipsis_substitution.q: Are you tired? — (A) Yes, I'm, (B) but (C) I'll finish (D) this first.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Không viết tắt ở cuối câu trả lời ngắn: "Yes, I am".
ellipsis_substitution.r: Câu trả lời ngắn: Yes, I am (không I'm)

ellipsis_substitution.q: Do you know if (A) the shop is open? — I (B) think (C) not it. (D) Let's check.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay mệnh đề phủ định: "I think not" hoặc "I don't think so".
ellipsis_substitution.r: I think not / I don't think so

ellipsis_substitution.q: Their house (A) is bigger (B) than ours one, (C) but it's (D) older.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Đại từ sở hữu "ours" đã thay cả cụm → không thêm "one": "than ours".

ellipsis_substitution.q: He can (A) speak French, and (B) so (C) does (D) his wife.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Lặp trợ động từ của vế trước (can) → "so can his wife".
ellipsis_substitution.r: so + trợ động từ (giống vế trước) + S

ellipsis_substitution.q: Will it rain tomorrow? — I don't believe it will rain.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay mệnh đề "it will rain" → I don't believe so.
w: "I don't believe it" = không tin nổi, sai nghĩa

ellipsis_substitution.q: I've lost my umbrella, so I need to buy a new umbrella.
o: I've lost my umbrella, so I need to buy a new one.
I've lost my umbrella, so I need to buy a new it.
I've lost my umbrella, so I need to buy a new ones.
I've lost my umbrella, so I need to buy one new.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tránh lặp danh từ số ít → a new one.
w: it không đứng sau tính từ

ellipsis_substitution.q: The teacher told us to clean the room, and we cleaned the room.
o: The teacher told us to clean the room, and we did so.
The teacher told us to clean the room, and we did it so.
The teacher told us to clean the room, and we did such.
The teacher told us to clean the room, and we did so it.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay cụm động từ lặp → do so.
ellipsis_substitution.r: do so = thay cụm động từ

ellipsis_substitution.q: My brother likes horror films, and I like horror films too.
o: My brother likes horror films, and so do I.
My brother likes horror films, and so am I.
My brother likes horror films, and so I do.
My brother likes horror films, and neither do I.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Đồng tình khẳng định: so + trợ động từ + S.

ellipsis_substitution.q: The population of Tokyo is larger than the population of Paris.
o: The population of Tokyo is larger than that of Paris.
The population of Tokyo is larger than those of Paris.
The population of Tokyo is larger than one of Paris.
The population of Tokyo is larger than it of Paris.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tránh lặp danh từ số ít trong so sánh → that of.

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Will it rain tomorrow?" — "I hope ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: "I hope not" = mong là không.

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Is the shop open?" — "I think ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: "I think so".

ellipsis_substitution.q: I don't like the red shoes, but I like the black ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay danh từ số nhiều → "ones".

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Can you come to the party?" — "I'm afraid ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: "I'm afraid not" = e rằng không.

ellipsis_substitution.q: He said he would help us, and he ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay động từ đã nói → trợ động từ "did".

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Are you coming?" — "I'd like ____, but I'm busy."
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tỉnh lược động từ sau "to": "I'd like to".
ellipsis_substitution.r: I'd like to / want to (bỏ V)

ellipsis_substitution.q: She asked me to call her, but I forgot ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: "forgot to (call)".

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Has he left?" — "It appears ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: "It appears / seems so".

ellipsis_substitution.q: If you haven't finished yet, please ____ by Friday.
ellipsis_substitution.e: "do so" thay "finish".

ellipsis_substitution.q: My laptop is older than ____ of my colleagues.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay "the laptops" (số nhiều) → "those of".

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Do you think she'll win?" — "I suspect ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: "I suspect so".

ellipsis_substitution.q: I need a pen. Do you have (A) one (B) that (C) I can (D) borrow it?
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thừa "it" (đã có "that").

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Is it going to snow?" — "I (A) hope (B) not (C) it," (D) she said.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thừa "it": "I hope not".

ellipsis_substitution.q: These apples are better than (A) the (B) one (C) we (D) bought last week.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay danh từ số nhiều "apples" → "ones".

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Will he come?" — "I don't think he will come."
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay mệnh đề → "so".

ellipsis_substitution.q: You must submit the form online. If you fail to submit it online, your application will be rejected.
o: You must submit the form online; if you fail to do so, your application will be rejected.
You must submit the form online; if you fail to do it so, your application will be rejected.
You must submit the form online; if you fail so, your application will be rejected.
You must submit the form online; if you fail doing so, your application will be rejected.
ellipsis_substitution.e: "do so" thay cụm động từ.

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Is he coming to the meeting?" — "I doubt ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: "I doubt it" = tôi không nghĩ vậy (khác "I think so").

ellipsis_substitution.q: Sam can't speak French, but his sister ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tỉnh lược: lặp lại trợ động từ của câu trước (can).

ellipsis_substitution.q: I'd prefer a seat by the window if there is ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: "one" thay danh từ đếm được số ít (a seat).

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Did we lose the match?" "I'm afraid ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: Xác nhận tin không vui → I'm afraid so (= we lost).
ellipsis_substitution.r: I'm afraid so / I'm afraid not

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Will the shop be open on Sunday?" "I think ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay cả mệnh đề "the shop will be open" → so.

ellipsis_substitution.q: I don't like the red shirt; I prefer the blue ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay cho danh từ đếm được số ít "shirt" → one.

ellipsis_substitution.q: I've already read these two books. Can you recommend some other ____?
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay cho danh từ số nhiều "books" → ones.

ellipsis_substitution.q: I can't swim, but my sister ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tỉnh lược: lặp lại trợ động từ "can" (= can swim).
ellipsis_substitution.r: Tỉnh lược bằng trợ động từ của câu gốc

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Have you finished?" "Not ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: "Not yet" = chưa (xong).

ellipsis_substitution.q: He promised to call, but he ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tỉnh lược: "didn't (call)".
ellipsis_substitution.r: Trợ động từ thay cho cả cụm động từ
w: "call" là động từ thường, không dùng "wasn't"

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Are you coming to the dinner?" "I'm afraid ____."
ellipsis_substitution.e: Từ chối lịch sự: I'm afraid not.
ellipsis_substitution.r: I'm afraid so / I'm afraid not

ellipsis_substitution.q: You don't have to come if you don't want ____.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Tỉnh lược động từ sau "want to" → giữ "to".
ellipsis_substitution.r: want / need / try + to (bỏ động từ)

ellipsis_substitution.q: The prices in this shop are higher than ____ in the supermarket.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Thay cho danh từ số nhiều "the prices" → those.
ellipsis_substitution.r: that (số ít) / those (số nhiều) of / in …

ellipsis_substitution.q: "Will it rain?" "(A) I (B) don't hope (C) so — we (D) want to go to the beach."
ellipsis_substitution.e: Không nói "I don't hope so" → "I hope not".
ellipsis_substitution.r: I hope not (không: I don't hope so)

ellipsis_substitution.q: My brother (A) likes (B) jazz, and (C) so (D) I do.
ellipsis_substitution.e: Đảo ngữ sau "so": "so do I".

ellipsis_substitution.q: These biscuits (A) are delicious. (B) Can I have (C) another ones? (D) Thanks.
ellipsis_substitution.e: "another" + số ít → "another one".

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the new law caused many protests.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "The" và trước "of" cần danh từ: introduction.
w: động từ không đứng sau the
V-ing ít dùng với the … of trong văn trang trọng

nominalization_formal_style.q: There has been a significant ____ in unemployment.
nominalization_formal_style.e: a + adj + DANH TỪ: a significant reduction.

nominalization_formal_style.q: The company announced its ____ to close two factories.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau tính từ sở hữu "its" cần danh từ: decision (to V).

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the bridge took three years.
nominalization_formal_style.e: the + N + of: the construction of the bridge.

nominalization_formal_style.q: Due to the ____ of the manager, the meeting was postponed.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "the" cần danh từ: absence (sự vắng mặt).

nominalization_formal_style.q: ____ the heavy rain, the match was cancelled.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Trước cụm danh từ (the heavy rain) dùng giới từ chỉ lý do: Owing to / Due to / Because of.
nominalization_formal_style.r: Owing to / Due to / Because of + N
w: although cần mệnh đề và sai nghĩa

nominalization_formal_style.q: Her ____ to help others is admirable.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau tính từ sở hữu "Her" cần danh từ: willingness (sự sẵn lòng).

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the results took longer than expected.
nominalization_formal_style.e: the + N + of: the analysis of the results.

nominalization_formal_style.q: We are grateful for your ____ in this matter.
nominalization_formal_style.e: your + N (sự giúp đỡ): assistance. "assistant" = người trợ lý, sai nghĩa.
w: ✓ danh từ chỉ sự giúp đỡ
danh từ chỉ người, sai nghĩa

nominalization_formal_style.q: The government's ____ of the problem was criticised.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh động từ làm danh từ: the government's handling of …
w: danh từ chỉ người, sai nghĩa

nominalization_formal_style.q: ____ of the data shows a clear trend.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Chủ ngữ là danh từ + of: Examination of the data.
nominalization_formal_style.r: N + of + N làm chủ ngữ
w: động từ không làm chủ ngữ
V-ing không đi với of khi làm chủ ngữ kiểu này

nominalization_formal_style.q: There is a growing ____ that action must be taken.
nominalization_formal_style.e: a + adj + N: a growing awareness.

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the plan depends on funding.
nominalization_formal_style.e: the + N + of: the success of the plan.

nominalization_formal_style.q: Applicants are required to ____ their documents by 1 May.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Văn trang trọng: submit (nộp) thay cho hand in.

nominalization_formal_style.q: The failure ____ the project was due to poor planning.
nominalization_formal_style.e: the failure of + N = sự thất bại của.
w: to dùng với failure to + V

nominalization_formal_style.q: The (A) develop (B) of new technology (C) has changed (D) the way we work.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "The" cần danh từ: "The development of".

nominalization_formal_style.q: The (A) increase (B) in prices (C) led to a (D) reduce in sales.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "a" cần danh từ: "a reduction in sales".

nominalization_formal_style.q: There (A) was a (B) dramatically (C) rise (D) in house prices.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "rise" phải là tính từ: "a dramatic rise".

nominalization_formal_style.q: The committee (A) delayed (B) the (C) approve (D) of the budget.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "the" cần danh từ: "the approval of the budget".

nominalization_formal_style.q: We (A) appreciate (B) you cooperation (C) on (D) this project.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Trước danh từ cần tính từ sở hữu: "your cooperation".

nominalization_formal_style.q: Prices rose sharply, which worried consumers.
o: The sharp rise in prices worried consumers.
The sharply rise in prices worried consumers.
The sharp rise in prices was worried consumers.
The sharp risen in prices worried consumers.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: rose sharply → the sharp rise in.
w: trạng từ không bổ nghĩa cho danh từ

nominalization_formal_style.q: Because the flight was delayed, we missed the meeting.
o: Owing to the flight delay, we missed the meeting.
Owing to the flight delayed, we missed the meeting.
Owing the flight delay, we missed the meeting.
Owing to the flight was delayed, we missed the meeting.
nominalization_formal_style.e: because + mệnh đề → owing to + cụm danh từ.
w: sau owing to cần danh từ
owing to không đi với mệnh đề

nominalization_formal_style.q: The manager decided to cancel the event, which surprised everyone.
o: The manager's decision to cancel the event surprised everyone.
The manager's decide to cancel the event surprised everyone.
The manager decision cancelling the event surprised everyone.
The manager's decision of cancel the event surprised everyone.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: decided to → decision to.
w: động từ sau sở hữu cách sai

nominalization_formal_style.q: They analysed the data carefully.
o: A careful analysis of the data was carried out.
A careful analyse of the data was carried out.
A carefully analysis of the data was carried out.
A careful analysis of the data carried out.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá + bị động trang trọng: a careful analysis … was carried out.
w: trạng từ không bổ nghĩa cho danh từ

nominalization_formal_style.q: Please tell us if your address changes.
o: Please inform us of any change of address.
Please inform us any change of address.
Please inform to us of any change of address.
Please inform us of any change address.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Văn trang trọng: inform sb of + danh từ.

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the new policy has been delayed.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: implement → implementation.

nominalization_formal_style.q: There has been a significant ____ in sales.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "a significant" → danh từ.

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the bridge took place in 1995.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "the opening of" = lễ khánh thành / việc mở.

nominalization_formal_style.q: Her ____ to the project was invaluable.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau tính từ sở hữu → danh từ.

nominalization_formal_style.q: ____ of the rules will result in disqualification.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "breach" (danh từ) = sự vi phạm (trang trọng).

nominalization_formal_style.q: The committee reached a ____ after hours of discussion.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "reach a decision".

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of English as a global language is undeniable.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá tính từ: important → importance.

nominalization_formal_style.q: Customers are requested to ____ from smoking.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "refrain from + V-ing" = (trang trọng) kiềm chế / không làm.
w: ít trang trọng, không đi với "from"

nominalization_formal_style.q: We ____ any inconvenience this may cause.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "We apologise for…" (văn trang trọng).

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the results took several weeks.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ: analysis.

nominalization_formal_style.q: Please ____ the attached document for further details.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "refer to" = tham khảo (trang trọng).

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of new employees is handled by HR.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: recruitment.

nominalization_formal_style.q: ____ to the museum is free for children under 12.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "Admission" = việc vào cửa.

nominalization_formal_style.q: The (A) develop (B) of new technologies (C) has changed (D) the industry.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "The" → danh từ "development".

nominalization_formal_style.q: Due to (A) the (B) increase (C) demand, (D) prices have risen.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Trước danh từ "demand" cần tính từ / phân từ: "the increased demand" (hoặc "the increase in demand").

nominalization_formal_style.q: The (A) fail (B) of the project (C) was due to (D) poor planning.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ "failure".

nominalization_formal_style.q: Because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled.
o: Owing to the bad weather, the flight was cancelled.
Owing to the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled.
Owing the bad weather, the flight was cancelled.
Owing to bad the weather, the flight was cancelled.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: "Owing to + N".

nominalization_formal_style.q: They decided to close the factory, and this shocked the workers.
o: The decision to close the factory shocked the workers.
The decide to close the factory shocked the workers.
The deciding close the factory shocked the workers.
The decision of close the factory shocked the workers.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: decided → decision.

nominalization_formal_style.q: When the new manager arrived, things changed quickly.
o: The arrival of the new manager led to rapid changes.
The arrive of the new manager led to rapid changes.
The arrival of the new manager led to rapidly changes.
The arriving the new manager led to rapid changes.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: arrived → arrival; quickly → rapid changes.

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the new policy led to widespread protests.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "The" và trước "of" cần danh từ → implementation (việc thực thi).

nominalization_formal_style.q: There has been a sharp ____ in the number of tourists.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "a sharp + danh từ" → increase (sự gia tăng).

nominalization_formal_style.q: Her ____ to resign surprised the board.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau tính từ sở hữu "Her" cần danh từ → decision (to + V).

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the factory caused 300 job losses.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "The + danh từ + of" → closure (việc đóng cửa).

nominalization_formal_style.q: ____ to meet the deadline will result in the contract being cancelled.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Chủ ngữ là danh từ: Failure to + V = việc không làm được …
w: động từ không làm chủ ngữ

nominalization_formal_style.q: The committee expressed its ____ with the results.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "its" cần danh từ → satisfaction (with).

nominalization_formal_style.q: Despite the ____ of evidence, the case was closed.
nominalization_formal_style.e: "the lack of + danh từ" = sự thiếu.
w: V-ing không đi với "the … of" ở đây

nominalization_formal_style.q: The ____ of the two companies was completed last month.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "The" và trước "of" cần danh từ → merger (vụ sáp nhập).
nominalization_formal_style.r: the merger of A and B

nominalization_formal_style.q: Thank you for your generous ____ to our charity this year.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "your generous" cần danh từ chỉ sự việc → contribution (sự đóng góp).
nominalization_formal_style.r: contribution (sự đóng góp) ≠ contributor (người đóng góp)

nominalization_formal_style.q: Because the weather was bad, the flight was delayed.
o: Due to the bad weather, the flight was delayed.
Due to the weather was bad, the flight was delayed.
Because of the weather was bad, the flight was delayed.
Despite the bad weather, the flight was delayed.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: "Because + mệnh đề" → "Due to + cụm danh từ".

nominalization_formal_style.q: The company expanded quickly, which surprised analysts.
o: The company's rapid expansion surprised analysts.
The company rapid expansion surprised analysts.
The company's rapidly expand surprised analysts.
The company's rapid expanding surprised analysts.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Danh từ hoá: expanded quickly → rapid expansion (tính từ + danh từ).
w: trạng từ + động từ không làm chủ ngữ

nominalization_formal_style.q: They analysed the data carefully, and this took two weeks.
o: A careful analysis of the data took two weeks.
A carefully analysis of the data took two weeks.
A careful analyse of the data took two weeks.
Careful analysing the data took two weeks.
nominalization_formal_style.e: analysed carefully → a careful analysis of (danh từ hoá).
w: trạng từ không bổ nghĩa cho danh từ

nominalization_formal_style.q: The (A) reduce (B) in costs (C) has allowed us (D) to lower prices.
nominalization_formal_style.e: Sau "The" cần danh từ → "reduction".
